rows.en: The heatbed temperature is abnormal; the heater may have a short circuit.
rows.zh: 热床温控异常，加热器可能短路。

rows.en: The heatbed temperature is abnormal; the heater may have an open circuit, or the thermal switch may be open.
rows.zh: 热床温控异常，加热器可能开路或热敏开关开路。

rows.en: The heatbed temperature is abnormal; the heater is over temperature.
rows.zh: 热床温控异常，加热器过温。

rows.en: A heatbed temperature control issue has been detected and the heating module may be damaged. Please power off the device immediately and follow the Wiki to replace the AC board.
rows.zh: 热床温控异常，加热模块损坏，请立即断开设备电源并停止使用。参考Wiki更换AC板。

rows.en: An abnormality occurs during the heating process of the heatbed; the heating modules may be broken.
rows.zh: 热床加热过程中出现异常，加热模块可能故障。

rows.en: The heatbed temperature control is abnormal; the AC board may be broken.
rows.zh: 热床温控异常，AC板可能故障。

rows.en: The heatbed has worked at full load for a long time. The temperature control system may be abnormal.
rows.zh: 热床长时间满负荷工作，温控系统可能异常。

rows.en: An abnormality occured in heating modules of heatbed previously. To continue using your printer, please refer to the wiki to troubleshoot.
rows.zh: 热床曾发生过加热模块故障，需要按wiki排除故障才能继续使用。

rows.en: The power supply voltage does not match the machine; the heatbed has been disabled.
rows.zh: 检测到电源电压与机器不匹配，热床加热已禁用

rows.en: The chamber target temperature is set too high, while the heatbed target temperature is set too low. Heatbed cooling has been skipped. It is recommended to set matching chamber and heatbed temperatures.
rows.zh: 腔体目标温度设定过高，而热床目标温度设定过低，已跳过热床降温。建议您设置匹配的腔温与热床温度。

rows.en: The temperature of the heated bed exceeds the limit and automatically adjusts to the limit temperature.
rows.zh: 热床设置温度超限，已经自动调整至限制温度。

rows.en: The chamber temperature is currently high, and the heatbed is cooling down slowly. It is recommended to open the top cover or front door to accelerate the cooling process.
rows.zh: 当前腔体温度较高，热床降温较慢。建议打开上盖或前门，以加快降温速度。

rows.en: The front cover of the toolhead fell off.
rows.zh: 工具头前盖脱落。

rows.en: The current sensor of Motor-A is abnormal. This may be caused by a failure of the hardware sampling circuit.
rows.zh: A电机电流传感器异常，可能是硬件采样电路故障。

rows.en: The current sensor of Motor-B is abnormal. This may be caused by a failure of the hardware sampling circuit.
rows.zh: B电机电流传感器异常，可能是硬件采样电路故障。

rows.en: The current sensor of Motor-Z is abnormal. This may be caused by a failure of the hardware sampling circuit.
rows.zh: Z电机电流传感器异常，可能是硬件采样电路故障。

rows.en: The extruder servo motor's current sensor is abnormal. A failure of the hardware sampling circuit may cause this.
rows.zh: 挤出电机电流传感器异常，可能是硬件采样电路故障。

rows.en: The hotend cooling fan speed is too slow or stopped. It may be stuck or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
rows.zh: 热端散热风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

rows.en: The hotend cooling fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
rows.zh: 热端散热风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

rows.en: The frequency of the extruder eddy current sensor is too low. The nozzle may not be installed, or the nozzle heat sink may be too far away from the sensor.
rows.zh: 挤出机涡流传感器频率过低，可能喷嘴未安装或喷嘴散热片距离传感器过远。

variants.093: The frequency of the extruder eddy current sensor is too low. The nozzle may not be installed, or the nozzle heat sink may be too far away from the sensor.
variants.22E: The frequency of the extruder eddy current sensor is too low. The nozzle may not be installed, or the nozzle heat sink may be too far away from the sensor.
variants.26A: The extruder eddy current sensor value is too low. The nozzle may not be installed.

rows.en: The sensitivity of the extruder eddy current sensor is low; the nozzle may not be installed correctly.
rows.zh: 挤出机涡流传感器灵敏度偏低，喷嘴可能未正确安装。

rows.en: The extruder eddy current sensor is not responding. The MC–TH communication link may be broken, or the sensor may be damaged.
rows.zh: 无法读取挤出机涡流传感器数据，可能遇到通信断路或者传感器损坏。

rows.en: Abnormal extruder eddy current signal. The sensor may be damaged, or the MC-TH communication may be abnormal.
rows.zh: 挤出机涡流传感器信号异常，可能涡流传感器已损坏或MC-TH通信异常。

rows.en: Z-axis motor rotation is obstructed; please check if foreign objects are stuck in the Z slider or Z timing pulley. Also, ensure the build plate is placed correctly to avoid collisions with surrounding structures.
rows.zh: Z轴电机转动受阻，请检查Z滑块和Z同步带轮是否有异物卡住，或热床打印板是否放置不正导致与周边结构发生碰撞。

variants.26A: The Z‑axis motor became stuck during movement. Please check for foreign objects on the Z‑axis sliders or timing belt pulleys, and check whether the extruder eddy current sensor is abnormal.

rows.en: The heatbed leveling data is abnormal. Please check whether there are any foreign objects on the heatbed and Z slider. If so, please remove them and try again.
rows.zh: 调平数据异常，请检查热床以及Z滑块附近是否有异物，如有请清理干净再重试。

rows.en: The frequency of the extruder eddy current sensor is too high. The sensor may be damaged, or the nozzle heat sink may be too close to the sensor.
rows.zh: 挤出机涡流传感器频率过高，可能传感器已损坏或喷嘴散热片距离传感器过近。

rows.en: Abnormal nozzle contact with the heatbed. Please check for residual foreign objects such as filament between the nozzle and the heatbed, as well as under the build plate, and ensure no jamming occurs during heatbed movement.
rows.zh: 喷嘴触碰热床异常，请检查喷嘴与热床之间、打印板下方是否有耗材等异物残留，并确认热床运动无卡滞。

rows.en: Nozzle presence detection failed: nozzle not installed or improperly installed.
rows.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败：喷嘴未安装或安装不到位。

rows.en: Abnormal signal jump detected in the extruder eddy current sensor, which may be caused by poor contact or a defective sensor.
rows.zh: 检测到挤出机涡流传感器数据异常跳变，可能是传感器接触不良或损坏。

rows.en: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. Excessive force detected on the nozzle. Please ensure the nozzle is installed correctly.
rows.zh: 喷嘴裹头位置检测失败。检测到喷嘴受力过大，请确认喷嘴已正确安装。

rows.en: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. The nozzle did not reach the metal sheet at the rear-right of the heatbed. Please clean the nozzle and remove any debris from that sheet.
rows.zh: 喷嘴裹头位置检测失败，未能触碰到热床右后侧钢片边缘，请清理喷嘴及该位置钢片边缘的异物。

variants.093: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. The nozzle did not reach the metal sheet at the rear-right of the heatbed. Please clean the nozzle and remove any debris from that sheet.
variants.22E: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. The nozzle did not touch the inner wall of the hole. Please clean the nozzle and the steel plate hole at the rear-right side of the heatbed.

rows.en: Too many retries on nozzle contact. Please verify the nozzle is installed correctly and check for foreign objects at the contact position.
rows.zh: 喷嘴触碰重试次数过多，请确认喷嘴已正确安装，并检查触碰位置是否有异物。

rows.en: Performing initial High-temperature Bed Leveling.
rows.zh: 正在执行首次高温热床调平

rows.en: The nozzle is covered with filament, or the build plate is crooked.
rows.zh: 喷嘴被耗材包裹或打印板放歪。

rows.en: External disturbance was detected on the heatbed acceleeration sensor. The sensor signal wire may not be affixed.
rows.zh: 热床加速度传感器检测到外部干扰，可能传感器信号线未固定。

rows.en: The heatbed acceleration sensor detected unexpected continuous force. The sensor may be stuck, or the analog front end may be broken.
rows.zh: 热床加速度传感器检测到异常持续外力，可能是传感器被卡住或发生了电路损坏。

rows.en: The extrusion motor driver is abnormal. The MOSFET may have a short circuit.
rows.zh: 挤出电机驱动异常，可能是开关管短路。

rows.en: The position sensor of extrusion motor is abnormal. The connection to the sensor may be loose.
rows.zh: 挤出电机位置传感器异常，可能是传感器排线松动。

rows.en: Extruder motor overload detected. The motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: 挤出电机过载，可能是电机故障。

rows.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the heater may have a short circuit.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，加热器可能短路。

rows.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the heater may have an open circuit.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，加热器可能开路。

rows.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the heater is overheated.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，加热器过温。

rows.en: Abnormal temperature control detected on the left extruder nozzle; the heating module may be damaged. Please disconnect the power immediately and stop using the device, and contact customer support for troubleshooting guidance.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，可能为加热模块损坏。请立即断开设备电源并停止使用，联系售后获取排故指引。

rows.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the sensor may have a short circuit. Please check whether the connector is properly plugged in.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，温度传感器可能短路，请检查连接器是否插好。

rows.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the sensor may have an open circuit.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，温度传感器可能开路。

rows.en: The left extruder nozzle temperature is abnormal and cannot reach the set value. This may be caused by an improperly installed nozzle silicone sock.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温度异常，无法加热至设定值，可能是喷嘴硅胶套未正确安装。

rows.en: The left nozzle temperature control is abnormal; the hot end may not be installed. If you want to heat the hot end without it being installed, please turn on maintenance mode.
rows.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，热端可能未安装。若需在热端未安装时也能加热，请打开维护模式。

rows.zh: X轴回零异常，请检查是否工具头被卡住或碳管阻力过大。

rows.en: Y axis homing abnormal: the timing belt may be loose.

rows.zh: 辅助挤出电机断路，可能线没插紧或电机故障。

rows.zh: 辅助挤出电机短路，可能是电机故障。

rows.en: The resistance of the Auxiliary extruder motor is abnormal; the motor may have failed.
rows.zh: 辅助挤出电机电阻异常，可能是电机故障。

rows.en: Auxiliary extruder motor current sensor error, possibly caused by a sampling circuit hardware failure.

rows.en: Low signal frequency detected on the right extruder eddy current sensor. The nozzle may not be installed, or the nozzle heat sink may be too far away from the sensor.
rows.zh: 右挤出机涡流传感器信号频率过低，可能喷嘴未安装或喷嘴散热片距离传感器过远。

rows.en: Low sensitivity detected in the right extruder eddy current sensor. Check the nozzle installation.

rows.en: Z-axis motor rotation is obstructed; please check if foreign objects are stuck in the Z slider or Z timing pulley. Also, ensure the build plate is placed correctly to avoid collisions with surrounding structures.
rows.zh: Z轴电机转动受阻，请检查Z滑块和Z同步带轮是否有异物卡住，或热床打印板是否放置不正导致与周边结构发生碰撞。

rows.en: High signal frequency detected on the right extruder eddy current sensor. The sensor may be damaged, or the nozzle heat sink may be too close to the sensor.

rows.en: The right nozzle touches the heating bed abnormally. Please check whether there is filament residue on the nozzle, foreign matter at the point where the nozzle contacts the bed, or severe deformation of the flow blocker.
rows.zh: 右侧喷嘴触碰热床异常，请检查喷嘴是否有耗材残留，触碰位置是否有异物，或堵嘴弹片是否严重变形。

rows.en: Nozzle offset calibration failed. Filament sticks to the nozzle, which may affect print quality. Please clean the nozzle and try again.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准失败。检测到喷嘴粘料，可能影响打印质量。请清理喷嘴后重试。

rows.en: Nozzle presence detection failed: Right extruder nozzle not installed or improperly installed.
rows.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败：右挤出机喷嘴未安装或安装不到位。

rows.en: An anomalous jump in the right extruder eddy current sensor data has been detected, potentially caused by poor sensor contact or a faulty sensor.
rows.zh: 检测到右挤出机涡流传感器数据异常跳变，可能是传感器接触不良或损坏。

rows.en: Too many retries on right nozzle contact. Please verify the nozzle is installed correctly and check for foreign objects at the contact position.
rows.zh: 右喷嘴触碰重试次数过多，请确认喷嘴已正确安装，并检查触碰位置是否有异物。

rows.en: Low signal frequency detected on the left extruder eddy current sensor. The sensor may be installed too far, or the sensor may be loose.
rows.zh: 左挤出机涡流传感器信号频率过低，可能传感器安装位置过远或传感器已松脱。

rows.en: Left extruder eddy current sensor sensitivity is low. Check sensor installation.
rows.zh: 左挤出机涡流传感器灵敏度偏低，涡流传感器可能未正确安装。

rows.en: Unable to read data from the left extruder eddy current sensor; there may be a communication break or sensor damage.
rows.zh: 无法读取左挤出机涡流传感器数据，可能遇到通信断路或者传感器损坏。

rows.en: The eddy current sensor signal of the left extruder is abnormal. The sensor may be damaged, or the MC-TH communication may be abnormal.
rows.zh: 左侧挤出机的涡流传感器信号异常，可能传感器已损坏或MC-TH通信异常。

rows.en: Z-axis motor rotation is obstructed; please check if foreign objects are stuck in the Z slider or Z timing pulley. Also, ensure the build plate is placed correctly to avoid collisions with surrounding structures.
rows.zh: Z轴电机转动受阻，请检查Z滑块和Z同步带轮是否有异物卡住，或热床打印板是否放置不正导致与周边结构发生碰撞。

rows.en: High signal frequency detected on the left extruder eddy current sensor. The sensor may be installed too close, or the sensor may be loose.
rows.zh: 左挤出机涡流传感器信号频率过高，可能传感器安装位置过近或传感器已松脱。

rows.en: The left nozzle touches the heating bed abnormally. Please check whether there is filament residue on the nozzle, foreign matter at the point where the nozzle contacts the bed, or severe deformation of the flow blocker.
rows.zh: 左侧喷嘴触碰热床异常，请检查喷嘴是否有耗材残留，触碰位置是否有异物，或堵嘴弹片是否严重变形。

rows.en: Nozzle presence detection failed: Left extruder nozzle not installed or improperly installed.
rows.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败：左挤出机喷嘴未安装或安装不到位。

rows.en: An anomalous jump in the left extruder eddy current sensor data has been detected, potentially caused by poor sensor contact or a faulty sensor.
rows.zh: 检测到左挤出机涡流传感器数据异常跳变，可能是传感器接触不良或损坏。

rows.en: Too many retries on left nozzle contact. Please verify the nozzle is installed correctly and check for foreign objects at the contact position.
rows.zh: 左喷嘴触碰重试次数过多，请确认喷嘴已正确安装，并检查触碰位置是否有异物。

rows.en: The nozzle offset calibration sensor frequency is too low. The sensor may be damaged.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器频率过低，可能传感器已损坏。

rows.en: Too many attempts at nozzle offset calibration, possibly due to purged filament between the nozzle and the heated base, or incorrect installation of the nozzle. Please inspect and retry.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准尝试次数过多，可能是喷嘴与加热底座之间有残余废料，或是喷嘴没有正确安装，请检查后重试校准。

rows.en: The nozzle offset calibration result shows significant deviation, possibly due to the heat insulation sheet on the right nozzle heating base not being installed. Please install it correctly and try again.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准结果差异过大，可能是右热端加热底座的隔热片没有安装，请检查并安装隔热片后重新进行校准。

rows.en: The signal of the nozzle offset calibration sensor is abnormal. The sensor may be damaged, or the wiring may not be connected properly.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器信号异常，可能传感器已损坏或接线松动。

rows.en: The nozzle offset calibration indicates significant deviation, possibly caused by an additional heat insulation sheet installed on the right nozzle heating base. Please verify this and attempt the calibration again.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准结果差异过大，可能是右热端加热底座的隔热片多安装了一片，请确认无误后重试校准。

rows.en: The nozzle offset calibration shows significant deviation, possibly due to incorrect installation of the nozzle or heating base. Please inspect and retry.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准结果差异过大，可能喷嘴或加热底座没有正确安装，请检查后重试校准。

rows.en: The nozzle offset calibration sensor frequency is too high. The sensor may be damaged.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器频率过高，可能传感器已损坏。

rows.en: The nozzle offset calibration sensor signal is too weak. It may be that the nozzle is sticky or the nozzle does not move above the sensor during calibration, causing the distance between the nozzle and the sensor to be too far.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器信号过弱，可能是喷嘴粘料或喷嘴在校准时没有运动到传感器上方，导致喷嘴与传感器的距离太远。

rows.en: The data of the force sensor of the Cutting Module is abnormal. The magnet on the Tool Holder may fall off or the force sensor may be damaged.
rows.zh: 刀切模组力传感器数据异常，可能刀架上的磁铁脱落或者力传感器已经损坏。

rows.en: Communication failure between cutting module and toolhead during Z-axis homing. Please check if the cutting module signal cable is loose or broken or verify if the force sensor coil is intact.
rows.zh: Z轴回零过程中，刀切模组与工具头通信失败，请检查刀切模组信号线是否松动断裂，或检查力传感器线圈是否完好。

rows.en: The force sensor of the Cutting Module is abnormal. The force sensor cable may be disconnected or the force sensor is damaged.
rows.zh: 刀切模组力传感器出现异常。可能是力传感器线缆脱落或力传感器损坏。

rows.en: Z-axis homing failed in cutting mode. Please check if there are any foreign objects in the Z-axis slider and Z-axis synchronous pulley.
rows.zh: 刀切模式Z轴回零失败，请检查Z滑块、Z同步带轮是否有异物。

rows.en: Communication failure between the Cutting Module and toolhead module. Please check if the Cutting module signal cable is loose or broken. It could also be due to a broken force sensor coil.
rows.zh: 刀切模组与工具头通信失败，请检查刀切模组信号线是否松动断裂，或检查力传感器线圈是否完好。

rows.en: Z-axis homing failed. Please check if the blade holder movement is smooth and ensure no foreign objects are at the contact position on the heatbed.
rows.zh: Z轴回零失败，请检查刀架运动是否顺畅，并确保热床接触位置无异物。

rows.en: Vision encoder patterns can not be recognized; possible reasons include vision encoder pattern distortion, light overexposure, and plate misplacement.
rows.zh: 视觉编码板图案识别异常，可能原因有：图案变形或破损、光源过曝、编码板摆放不对等。

rows.en: The left hotend cooling fan speed is too slow or stopped. The fan may be stuck or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
rows.zh: 左侧热端冷却风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

rows.en: The left hotend cooling fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
rows.zh: 左侧热端冷却风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

rows.en: Air-door calibration failed. Please check if there is any foreign object blocking the damper.
rows.zh: 风门标定失败，请检查风门是否有异物卡住。

rows.en: Obstacle detected under the heatbed. Please remove it to ensure proper printing.
rows.zh: 热床底部存在障碍物影响打印，请清除障碍物。

rows.en: Heated bed leveling failed. This may be caused by foreign objects on or beneath the build plate, or a tilted heated bed. Continuing printing may damage the build plate. Please remove any debris or manually level the bed before retrying.
rows.zh: 热床调平失败，可能由打印板上下有异物、热床倾斜导致。继续打印可能损坏打印板，请清理异物或手动调平热床后重试。

rows.zh: 为提升首层打印质量，设备正在进行热床保温，请稍后。

rows.en: Data transmission over the serial port is abnormal; the software system may be faulty.
rows.zh: 通过串行端口传输数据异常；软件系统可能有故障。

rows.en: G-code data error detected. The system has automatically reloaded the G-code and resumed task.
rows.zh: 检测到 G-code 数据异常，系统已自动重新获取并继续任务。

rows.en: Sliced file abnormality detected multiple times. Task canceled. Please check the sliced file.
rows.zh: 多次检测到切片文件异常，任务已取消，请检查切片。

rows.en: G-code verification error. The system has automatically reacquired the data and resumed task.
rows.zh: G-code 校验异常，已自动重新获取并恢复任务。

rows.en: The system voltage is unstable. Triggering the power failure protection function.
rows.zh: 系统电压不稳定，触发断电保护功能。

rows.en: Chamber heating failed. The heater may not be blowing hot air.
rows.zh: 腔温加热失败，腔温加热器热风产出可能异常。

rows.en: Chamber heating failed. Possible causes: the chamber is not fully enclosed, ambient temperature is too low, or the power supply heat dissipation vent is blocked.
rows.zh: 腔温加热失败。可能是因为舱门未关闭，或者外界温度过低。

rows.en: Chamber heating failed. The power supply temperature may be too high.
rows.zh: 腔温加热失败，电源可能出现过热。

rows.en: Chamber heating failed. The speed of the heating fan is too low.
rows.zh: 腔温加热失败，加热风扇转速过低。

rows.en: Chamber heating failed. The thermal resistance is too high.
rows.zh: 腔温加热失败，加热链路热阻过大。

rows.en: Chamber heating failed. The air duct could not switch to chamber temperature heating mode.
rows.zh: 腔温加热失败，风道无法切换至进入腔温保持模式。

rows.en: High chamber temperature detected. If the hotend is overheating or emitting smoke, immediately power off the printer. Please refer to the Wiki for detailed troubleshooting instructions.
rows.zh: 检测到腔温过高，如出现热端过热或冒烟现象，请立即关闭电源。请前往 Wiki 查看详细的排查与处理指南。

rows.en: The communication of chamber temperature controller is abnormal.
rows.zh: 腔温控制器通信异常。

rows.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The heater may have a short circuit.
rows.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，加热器可能短路。

rows.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The heater may have an open circuit or the thermal fuse may have burned out.
rows.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，加热器可能开路或热保险丝断开。

rows.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The heater is over temperature.
rows.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，加热器过温。

rows.en: A chamber heater temperature control issue has been detected and the heating module may be damaged. Please power off the device immediately and follow the Wiki to replace the AC board.
rows.zh: 腔温加热器温控异常，加热器超温，请立即断开设备电源并停止使用。参考Wiki更换AC板。

rows.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，温度传感器可能开路。

rows.zh: 腔温加热器1加热失败。

rows.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The AC board may be broken.
rows.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，AC板可能故障。

rows.en: The chamber heater 1 has worked at full load for a long time. The temperature control system may be abnormal.
rows.zh: 腔温加热器1长时间满载工作，温控系统可能异常。

rows.en: The power supply voltage does not match the machine; chamber heater 1 has been disabled.
rows.zh: 检测到电源电压与机器不匹配，腔温加热器 1 已禁用。

rows.en: The temperature of chamber heater is abnormal. The heater may have an open circuit or the thermal fuse may be in effect.
rows.zh: 腔温加热器温控异常，加热器可能开路或热保险丝断开。

rows.zh: 灭火器电机复位卡滞，请小幅度左右拧动应急手轮直至阻力变小，断开灭火器电源后重新插上电源线。

rows.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴的电机与位置传感器通信异常。如重启设备无法解决问题，请联系售后服务。

rows.en: Laser module detected. Please remove the hotend from the hotend rack to prevent laser processing debris from affecting printing performance.
rows.zh: 检测到激光模组，请取下热端挂架上的热端，以防激光加工碎屑影响热端打印功能。

rows.en: Laser module detected. Please install the right nozzle correctly to ensure proper Laser Module Mounting Calibration.
rows.zh: 已检测到激光模组，请正确安装右喷嘴，以确保后续激光模组挂载校准正常。

rows.en: Hotend holder motor is disconnected or has an open-circuit fault. Please check the motor’s flat cable connection.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机未连接或存在开路异常，请检查电机软排线连接是否正常。

rows.en: Inter-phase short circuit on hotend holder motor. If restarting doesn’t resolve the issue, please contact support.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机相间短路异常。如重启打印机无法解决，建议联系售后服务。

rows.en: Hotend holder motor has abnormal or unbalanced three-phase resistance. If restarting doesn’t help, please contact support.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机三相电阻异常或不平衡。如重启打印机无法解决，建议联系售后服务。

rows.en: Hotend holder motor is stalled. Please check for foreign objects or collisions with the toolhead.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机堵转，请检查是否有异物卡住，或是否与工具头发生碰撞。

rows.en: Current sensor fault on hotend holder motor. This may be caused by a sampling circuit failure. If restarting the printer doesn’t resolve the issue, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机电流传感器异常，可能是采样电路故障。如重启打印机无法解决，建议联系售后服务。

rows.en: Communication error between the hotend holder motor and the position sensor. If restarting fails, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机与位置传感器通信异常。如重启打印机无法解决问题，建议联系售后服务。

rows.en: The MOS tubes of the Hotend Holder motor drive board are short-circuited. If restarting the printer does not resolve the problem, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机驱动板MOS管短路异常，如果重启打印机无法解决问题，建议联系售后服务。

rows.en: MC communication with Rack Control Board failed. Please check if the connection cable is properly plugged in.
rows.zh: MC与挂架控制板通信异常，请检查连接线是否连接牢靠。

rows.en: Multiple motion step losses are detected. Please first check if there is any foreign object obstruction or abnormal noise on the tool head. You may continue and observe the quality. If obvious layer misalignment occurs, refer to the Wiki for maintenance.
rows.zh: 检测到多次运动丢步，请先检查工具头是否存在异物阻挡或异响。可继续执行并观察状态，若出现明显错层，请参考Wiki进行维护。

rows.en: The media pipeline is malfunctioning. Please restart the device. If multiple attempts fail, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 媒体链路错误。请重启机器，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Live View camera is not connected. Please check the hardware and cable connections.
rows.zh: 未连接实况摄像头，请检查硬件及线路连接。

rows.en: The Liveview camera firmware update encountered an error. Please restart the printer and try to upgrade again.
rows.zh: 实况相机固件升级出错，请重启机器后重试升级。

rows.en: The Liveview camera firmware update encountered an error. Please restart the printer and try to upgrade again.
rows.zh: 实况相机固件升级出错，请重启机器后重试升级。

rows.en: The Liveview camera firmware update encountered an error. Please restart the printer and try to upgrade again.
rows.zh: 实况相机固件升级出错，请重启机器后重试升级。

rows.en: Insufficient internal storage may prevent printing. Please format the SD card to free up space.
rows.zh: 机内存储空间不足，可能导致无法打印。请格式化SD卡释放空间。

rows.en: Not enough space on MicroSD Card. Video recording and timelapse recording cannot be performed. Please clear some space.
rows.zh: MicroSD卡空间不足，可能无法进行录像或者延时摄影，请删除MicroSD卡中部分文件。

rows.zh: 没有插入MicroSD卡，无法用实况相机录制延时摄影。

rows.zh: 机内存储空间不足，可能无法录制延时摄影。请先清理机内存储中的文件，释放空间后再尝试录制。

rows.en: Failed to connect to the internet. Please check the network connection.
rows.zh: 设备连接服务器失败，请检查网络连接。

rows.en: Device login failed; please check your account information.
rows.zh: 账号登录失败，请检查账号信息。

rows.en: Failed to connect to the internet; please check the network connection.
rows.zh: 无法连接互联网；请检查网络连接。

rows.en: Unauthorized user: please check your account information.
rows.zh: 未经授权的用户：请检查您的账户信息。

rows.en: Failed to connect to the internet; please check the network connection.
rows.zh: 无法连接互联网；请检查网络连接。

rows.en: Streaming function error. Please check the network and try again. You can restart or update the printer if the issue persists.
rows.zh: 流媒体服务异常，检查网络后重试。如仍未恢复，可重启或更新打印机。

rows.en: Liveview service login failed; please check your network connection.
rows.zh: 流媒体服务登录失败，请检查网络连接。

rows.en: Time synchronization failed
rows.zh: 时间同步失败

rows.en: Wireless hardware error: Please turn Wi-Fi off and back on, or restart your device.
rows.zh: 网络硬件异常，请关闭Wi-Fi后重新打开，或重启设备。

rows.en: The MC module is malfunctioning; please restart the device or check device cable connection.
rows.zh: MC模块工作异常，请尝试重启设备。请检查排线连接。

rows.en: The toolhead is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: 工具头模块工作异常，请尝试重启设备。

rows.en: The AMS module is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: AMS模块工作异常，请尝试重启设备。

rows.en: The Filament Buffer module is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: 缓冲器模块工作异常，请重启设备。

rows.en: Internal service is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: 内部服务异常，请重启设备。

rows.en: A system panic occurred. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: 系统崩溃，需要断电重启。

rows.en: The Toolhead expansion module is malfunctioning. Please power off, check the connection, and restart the device.
rows.zh: 工具头拓展模块工作异常，请断电排查线路连接情况，并重启设备。

rows.en: A system hang occurred. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: 系统出现卡死，需要断电重启。

rows.en: A system hang occurred. It has been recovered by automatic restart.
rows.zh: 系统出现卡死，已自动重启恢复。

rows.en: System state is abnormal; please restore to factory settings.
rows.zh: 系统状态异常，请恢复出厂设置。

rows.en: The screen is malfunctioning; please restart the device.
rows.zh: 屏幕出现故障；请重新启动设备。

rows.en: The MC motor controller module is malfunctioning. Please power off, check the connection, and restart the device.
rows.zh: MC电机控制器工作异常，请断电排查线路连接情况，并重启设备。

rows.en: The induction hotend rack is malfunctioning. Please power off, check the connection, and restart the device.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架工作异常，请断电排查线路连接情况，并重启设备。

rows.en: Some external modules are incompatible with the device's firmware version, which may affect normal operation. Please go to the "Firmware" page while connected to the internet to upgrade.
rows.zh: 检测到部分配件与设备固件版本不匹配，可能影响正常使用。请在联网状态下前往“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: Hardware incompatible; please check the Micro Lidar.
rows.zh: 硬件不兼容，请检查激光雷达。

rows.en: The Chamber Temperature Controller module is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: 腔温控制器工作异常，请重启设备。

rows.en: The current temperature is too low. In order to protect you and your printer, printing tasks, moving an axis and other operations are disabled. Please move the printer to an environment above 10 degrees Celsius.
rows.zh: 当前环境温度过低。为了保护您和打印机的安全，打印任务、轴移动等操作将被禁用。请将打印机移动到10度以上的环境使用。

rows.en: The current firmware version is abnormal and job cannot start. Please ensure the device is connected to the network and go to the "Firmware" page to update.
rows.zh: 当前固件版本异常，无法发起任务。请确保设备已联网，并前往“固件”页面完成升级。

rows.en: The Toolhead expansion module is malfunctioning. Please power off, check the connection, and restart the device.
rows.zh: 工具头拓展模块工作异常，请断电排查线路连接情况，并重启设备。

rows.en: Wireless hardware error: please turn off/on WiFi or restart the device.
rows.zh: 网络硬件异常，请关闭/开启WIFi或者重启设备。

rows.en: The SD Card controller is malfunctioning.
rows.zh: SD卡访问异常。

rows.en: Some modules are incompatible with the device's firmware version, which may affect use. Please go to the "Firmware" page to update after connected to the internet, or you may update offline according to wiki.
rows.zh: 检测到部分配件与设备固件版本不匹配，可能影响正常使用。请在联网后前往“固件”页面进行升级。也可查看wiki进行离线升级。

rows.en: Micro SD Card capacity is insufficient to cache print files.
rows.zh: SD卡容量不足，无法缓存打印文件。

rows.en: User information has expired; please log in again.
rows.zh: 用户信息已过期，请重新登录账号。

rows.en: MicroSD Card performance degradation has been detected. It may affect print jobs, logs, and video records. Please format or change the MicroSD card.
rows.zh: MicroSD卡读写速率低，可能影响打印性能。

rows.en: Failed to download task; please check your network connection.
rows.zh: 下载任务失败，请检查网络连接。

rows.en: Failed to report task state; please check your network connection.

rows.en: The content of task file is unreadable; please resend the task.
rows.zh: 任务文件异常，请重新启动任务。

rows.en: The task file is unauthorized.
rows.zh: 任务文件未授权。

rows.en: Failed to resume previous print.
rows.zh: 恢复上次打印失败。

rows.en: Authorized slicing feature detected. Ensure all required authorizations are obtained before use. Bambu Lab cannot authorize such use of the product and assumes no liability for any use undertaken without the required authorizations, or otherwise not in compliance with applicable requirements or laws. rows.zh: 检测到您正在使用需要授权的切片功能。请先确认已获得所有必要授权。Bambu Lab 无权授予相关许可，且对未经授权或不符合法律法规要求的使用不承担责任。详情请查看 Wiki。

rows.en: The firmware of AMS A does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: AMS A固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: The firmware of Laser Module does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: 激光模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: The firmware of Air Pump does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: 气泵固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: The firmware of Cutting Module does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: 刀切模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: Communication error detected with AMS, AMS lite or AMS HT. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer when it is idle.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS、AMS lite 或 AMS HT 通信异常，请在打印机空闲时重新插拔模块连接线，或重启打印机。

rows.en: Unknown module detected, please try updating the firmware to the latest version.
rows.zh: 检测到未知模块接入，请尝试升级固件至最新版本。

rows.en: Emergency Stop Button is not in the right position. Please follow the Wiki to install it.
rows.zh: 急停按钮未正确安装，请按照Wiki正确安装。

rows.en: Safety Key is not inserted. Please follow the Wiki to install it.
rows.zh: 未插入安全钥匙，请按照Wiki正确安装。

rows.en: The bed temperature exceeds the filament's vitrification temperature, which may cause a nozzle clog. Please keep the front door of the printer open or lower the bed temperature.
rows.zh: 热床温度超过了耗材丝的软化温度，可能造成堵塞。请保持打印机的前门打开或者降低热床温度。

rows.en: The BirdsEye Camera is not installed. Power off the device and install the camera by referring to the instructions in the Wiki.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头未安装，请断电后参考 Wiki 安装。

rows.en: Before using a Laser/Cutting Module, the pose of the BirdsEye Camera needs to be determined. Please complete the setup to calibrate the camera.
rows.zh: 在使用激光/刀切模组前，需要确定俯视摄像头的位置和姿态。请点击“初始化”来校准俯视摄像头。

rows.en: Please slide in Laser Module and lock the quick-release lever.
rows.zh: 请插入激光模组并锁紧快拆锁扣。

rows.en: Please plug in the module connector.
rows.zh: 请插入模组的连接线。

rows.en: Laser module detected for the first time. Complete the setup (~4 min) before use for precise cutting and engraving. Also, ensure the H2.0 screw at the back securing the air pump is removed.
rows.zh: 检测到激光组件首次接入。为确保激光雕刻精度，请在使用前进行初始化，预计耗时约 4 分钟。同时，请确认已拆除打印机背部的 H2.0 气泵螺钉。

rows.en: The Laser Module needs calibration to get the focus position. Please perform mounting calibration before use. (about 2 minutes)
rows.zh: 激光组件需要校准，以获取精确的焦点位置。请在使用前执行挂载校准。耗时大约2分钟。

rows.en: New Cutting Module connected. To ensure more precise cutting, please set it up before use. (about 3 minutes)
rows.zh: 检测到刀切模组首次接入。为了切割更加精确，请在使用前初始化。耗时约3分钟。

rows.en: The Cutting Module needs calibration to get the tool position. Please perform the mounting calibration before use. (about 2-4 minutes)
rows.zh: 刀切模组需要校准，以获取精确的刀尖位置。请在使用前执行挂载校准。耗时约2-4min。

rows.en: Please slide in cutting module and fasten the quick release lever. If already installed, the module might not be properly aligned. Please try reinstalling it.
rows.zh: 请安装刀切模组并锁紧快拆锁扣。如已安装，可能是模组没有滑入到位，请尝试重新安装。

rows.en: Please plug in the module connector
rows.zh: 请插入模组的连接线。

rows.en: The TPU-specific hotend is not compatible with the left extruder. Please replace it with another compatible hotend.
rows.zh: TPU高流量套件与左挤出机不兼容，请更换其他兼容的热端。

rows.en: The laser module has been used for a long time. Please clean it promptly to avoid affecting laser processing.
rows.zh: 当前激光模组使用时间较长，请及时清理烟尘，避免影响激光加工。

rows.en: The Live View Camera is dirty or obstructed; please clean it and continue.
rows.zh: 实况摄像头脏污或被遮挡，请清理后继续。

rows.en: The Toolhead Camera is dirty or obstructed; please clean it and continue.
rows.zh: 工具头摄像头脏污或被遮挡，请清理后继续。

rows.en: Laser Safety Window is not installed.
rows.zh: 激光防护视窗未安装

rows.en: The door seems to be open.
rows.zh: 检测到打印过程中开门。

rows.en: The bed temperature exceeds filament's vitrification temperature, which may cause nozzle clog. Please keep the front door of the printer open. Door open detection has been temporarily turned off.
rows.zh: 热床温度超过了耗材丝的软化温度，可能造成堵塞。请保持打印机的前门打开，本次打印已经临时关闭了开门检测功能。

rows.en: Auto Fire Extinguishing System detected. It is recommended to conduct a Fire Drill to become familiar with the operation process.
rows.zh: 检测到自动灭火系统已接入，建议进行一次灭火演练，熟悉操作流程。

rows.en: The task has been completed. Automatic air purification is in progress.
rows.zh: 任务完成，自动空气净化已开启。

rows.en: The factory data of the AP board is abnormal; please replace the AP board with a new one.
rows.zh: AP板出厂数据异常，请更换新AP板。

rows.en: The factory data of AP board is abnormal; please replace the AP board with a new one.
rows.zh: AP板出厂数据异常，请更换新AP板。

rows.en: MQTT Command verification failed. Please update Studio/Suite (including the network plugin) or Handy to the latest version, then restart the software and try again.
rows.zh: MQTT 命令校验失败。请更新 Studio/Suite（含网络插件）、或 Handy 至最新版本，并重启软件后重试。

rows.en: The BirdsEye Camera is malfunctioning. Please try restarting the device. If the issue persists after multiple restarts, check the camera connection status or contact customer support.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头工作异常，请尝试重启设备。若多次重启仍未恢复，请检查摄像头连接状态或联系客服人员。

rows.en: Laser Module firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: 激光模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: The accessory firmware does not match the device. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: 配件固件与设备不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: AMS A certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.

rows.zh: 自动灭火装置模块认证失败，请插拔模块连接线或重启设备。

rows.en: Filament Track Switch certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
rows.zh: 耗材变轨器认证失败，请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

rows.en: Ethernet accessory communication error. Please restart the device.
rows.zh: 网口配件通信异常，请重启设备。

rows.en: Purifier certification failed. Please reconnect the purifier cable or restart the device and try again.
rows.zh: 净化器认证失败，请拔插净化器连接线或重启设备后重试。

rows.en: Hotend 1 authentication failed. Please switch the hotend or restart the printer.
rows.zh: 热端 1 认证失败，请切换热端或者重启打印机。

rows.en: Time-lapse kit communication error. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
rows.zh: 延时摄影套件通信异常，请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

rows.en: The External Exhaust Fan certification failed. Please restart the printer or reconnect the fan cable.
rows.zh: 外部排气风扇模块认证失败。请重启打印机或拔插风扇连接线。

rows.en: Filament Buffer certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
rows.zh: 耗材缓冲器认证失败，请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

rows.zh: MC 认证失败，可能是通信异常，请重启设备。

rows.en: Studio / Suite is not compatible with this device. Please download the latest version from bambulab.com. Keep the software connected to the device during slicing.
rows.zh: Studio / Suite 与设备不兼容。请前往 bambulab.com 下载最新版本软件。切片时，需要保持软件与设备连接。

rows.en: Purifier firmware version error. Please go to the Settings-Firmware page to update.
rows.zh: 净化器固件版本异常，请前往设置-固件页面进行升级。

rows.zh: 耗材缓冲器固件版本异常，请前往设置-固件页面进行升级。

rows.zh: 设备处于工程态，请注意信息安全。

rows.zh: U 盘写入异常，录像、延时摄影或文件保存可能失败。请安全弹出并重新插入；若仍异常，请格式化或更换 U 盘。

rows.en: The feeder module is offline. Please check if the feeder module connection cable is loose.
rows.zh: 进料模块离线，请检查进料模块连接线是否松动。

rows.en: A feeder module replacement is detected. Please ensure that the corresponding extrusion gear and nozzle have been replaced, and manually update the nozzle type in the printer.
rows.zh: 检测到进料模块更换，请确认已更换对应挤出轮和喷嘴，并在打印机上手动更新喷嘴类型。

rows.en: Carbon rods need cleaning now.
rows.zh: 请进行碳管清洁。

rows.en: Threaded rods need lubrication now.
rows.zh: 请清洁并润滑：丝杆。

rows.en: Linear rods need cleaning and lubrication now.
rows.zh: 请清洁并润滑：光杆。

rows.en: Please clean and lubricate the X-axis linear rail and YZ-axis linear rods.
rows.zh: 请清洁并润滑：X轴线轨、Y轴光杆以及Z轴光杆。

variants.093: Please clean and lubricate the X-axis linear rail and YZ-axis linear rods.
variants.094: Please clean and lubricate the X-axis linear rail, YZ-axis linear rods, and the extruder lift linear rail.
variants.239: Please clean and lubricate the X-axis linear rail, YZ-axis linear rods, and the extruder lift linear rail.
variants.31B: Please clean and lubricate the X-axis linear rail, YZ-axis linear rods, and the extruder lift linear rail.

rows.en: Please clean and lubricate the Induction Hotend Latch and the linear rods of the Hotend Change System.
rows.zh: 请对感应热端锁紧拉柄及自动热端切换系统光杆进行清洁和润滑。

rows.en: The Induction Hotend Latch may be worn. To ensure proper induction hotend switching, please replace the  Induction Hotend Latch and clean the rods of Induction Hotend Rack.
rows.zh: 感应热端锁紧拉柄可能出现磨损，为保障热端取放功能正常，请及时更换感应热端锁紧拉柄并清洁感应热端挂架光杆。

rows.en: The AMS A assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS A 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS A assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS A 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS A assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS A 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS A The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS A The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机校准参数错误，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: The AMS A assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS A The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS A The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS A The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS A The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS A The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS A The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS A Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS A 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS A The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 3 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS A 3 槽助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 3 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS A 3 槽助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot 3 cannot be identified.
rows.zh: 无法识别 AMS A 料卷 3 的标签内容。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 3 filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位3耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 3 filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位3耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 4. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS A槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 4. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS A槽位4的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 4. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS A槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 4. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS A槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 4. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS A槽位4的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 4. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during the filament loading or unloading. Please pull out the filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS A槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是进退料过程卡住导致RFID标签无法转动，请拔出耗材重试。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4's filament may be broken in AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4耗材可能断在AMS中。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS A has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS A 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS A Slot 4 filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS A槽位4耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS A Slot 4 filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS A 槽 4 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽 4 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS A 4 槽助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS A 4 槽助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot 4 cannot be identified.
rows.zh: 无法识别 AMS A 料卷 4 的标签内容。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS A Slot 4 filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位4耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS A uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS A 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS A will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS A 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS A RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS A RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot1 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS A槽位1 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS A RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS A RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot2 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS A槽位2 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot3 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS A槽位3 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.zh: AMS A槽位4 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS A The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS A Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS A 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: Filament buffer position signal error: the position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 缓冲区位置信号异常，可能位置传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS Hub communication is abnormal; the cable may be not well connected.
rows.zh: 多通缓冲通信异常，可能连接线异常。

rows.en: The filament buffer signal is abnormal; the spring may be stuck, or the filament may be tangled.
rows.zh: 缓冲区位置信号异常，可能缓冲区弹簧卡住或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: The filament cutter sensor is malfunctioning; please check whether the connector is properly plugged in.
rows.zh: 切料传感器异常。请检查连接器是否正确插入。

rows.en: The filament cutter's cutting distance is too large. The XY motor may lose steps.
rows.zh: 切刀刀柄行程异常，可能电机丢步或XY未回零。

rows.en: The filament cutter handle has not been released. The handle or blade may be jammed, or there could be an issue with the filament sensor connection.
rows.zh: 切刀刀柄未松开，刀柄或刀片可能被卡住，或耗材霍尔接线异常。

rows.en: AMS A communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS A 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS A is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable and try again.
rows.zh: AMS A 已断开连接，请拔插连接线后重试。

rows.en: The AMS is disabled; please load filament from the spool holder.
rows.zh: AMS已禁用，请从料盘支架加载耗材。

rows.en: Abnormal number or type of connected AMS units detected. Please refer to the Wiki for supported AMS combinations and adjust the current connection.
rows.zh: 检测到接入的 AMS 数量或类型异常。请查阅 Wiki 了解支持的 AMS 组合，并调整当前接入方式。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

variants.094: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.20P: The PTFE tube connection between the toolhead and buffer is incorrect. Please ensure the upper port of the buffer is connected to the left extruder, and the lower port is connected to the right extruder.
variants.239: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.31B: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.

rows.en: AMS A was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS A离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS A and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS A与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: A new AMS detected. Please set it up to check which extruder the AMS is connected to.
rows.zh: 检测到新AMS接入，需要进行一次初始化，检查AMS连接到了哪一侧挤出机。

rows.en: AMS A is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS A正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS A is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS A 与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: External filament printing detected while the filament tracker is connected. Stop the current print. Disconnect the filament tracker and restart the print to use external filament.
rows.zh: 检测到在连接变轨器的情况下使用外挂耗材打印，请停止当前打印。如需使用外挂耗材打印，请断开变轨器后重新发起打印。

rows.en: The AMS A Slot 1 is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A 槽位1 过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.en: Timeout purging old filament. Possible cause: filament stuck or the extruder/nozzle clog.
rows.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，可能是耗材卡住或挤出机/喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: AMS filament ran out. Please put a new filament into the same slot in AMS and resume.
rows.zh: AMS耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file.
rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.zh: AMS A槽2的耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.en: Failed to feed the AMS A Slot 2 filament into the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A槽2的耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.en: Failed to extrude the filament. Possible cause: extruder or nozzle clog.
rows.zh: 耗材挤出异常，可能是挤出机或喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: Failed to pull back the AMS A Slot 2 filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A槽2的耗材从工具头退回失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.en: Failed to feed the AMS A Slot 2 filament. Please trim the end of the filament and check if the spool is stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A槽2的耗材送出失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the AMS A Slot 3 filament from the extruder. Possible cause: clogged extruder or broken filament inside the extruder.

rows.en: Failed to feed the AMS A Slot 3 filament into the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

rows.zh: AMS A槽3的耗材从工具头退回失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.en: Failed to feed the AMS A Slot 4 filament into the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A槽4的耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.en: Failed to extrude the filament. Possible cause: extruder or nozzle clog.

rows.zh: AMS A槽4的耗材从工具头退回失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.en: Failed to feed the AMS A Slot 4 filament. Please trim the end of the filament and check if the spool is stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A槽4的耗材送出失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

rows.en: The Filament Track Switch is offline. Please check for disconnected cables or loose connectors.
rows.zh: 耗材变轨器离线，请检查连接线是否断开或接头是否松动。

rows.en: The Filament Track Switch was connected during AMS initialization. Please unplug the Filament Track Switch and reconnect it after AMS initialization is complete.
rows.zh: 检测到在 AMS 初始化过程中接入了耗材变轨器。请先拔出耗材变轨器，待 AMS 初始化完成后再接入重试。

rows.en: Filament Track Switch detected during loading/unloading. Please remove it and reconnect after the process is complete.
rows.zh: 检测到在进退料期间接入了耗材变轨器。请先拔出变轨器，待进退料完成后再重新接入。

rows.en: The Filament Track Switch was connected while filament is still in the extruder or buffer. Please unplug the switch, manually unload the filament, then reconnect and try again.
rows.zh: 检测到接入耗材变轨器时，挤出机或缓冲器内仍有残余耗材。请先拔出变轨器，手动抽出耗材或退料后，再重新接入并重试。

rows.en: Filament was detected in the extruder or filament buffer when the Filament Track Switch was unplugged. Reconnect the switch first, manually unload the filament, and then unplug it.
rows.zh: 检测到拔出耗材变轨器时，挤出机或缓冲器中仍有耗材。请先重新接入耗材变轨器，手动退料后再将其拔出。

rows.en: AMS A Heater 1, heater malfunction or abnormal current sensor detected.
rows.zh: AMS A 加热器 1 检测到加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS A The heater 1 is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器1离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS A The heater 1 is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器1短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS A The heater 1 is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器1异常发热。

rows.en: AMS A Heater 2, heater malfunction or abnormal current sensor detected.
rows.zh: AMS A 加热器 2 检测到加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS A The heater 2 is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器2离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS A The heater 2 is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器2短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS A The heater 2 is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器2异常发热。

rows.en: AMS A is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS A与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: The AMS has been detected. Please set it up to confirm which side of the Filament Track Switch inlet the AMS is connected to.
rows.zh: 检测到AMS接入，需要进行一次初始化，以确认AMS连接到了耗材变轨器哪一侧进料口。

rows.en: A filament jam or component damage may have occurred at the Filament Track Switch.
rows.zh: 耗材变轨器处可能出现卡料或部件损坏。

rows.en: Filament is blocked at the inlet of the filament track switch.
rows.zh: 耗材变轨器入口处存在耗材阻塞。

rows.en: AMS setup error: Filament track switch detected online, but filament did not pass through. Please check the PTFE tube connection between the AMS and the filament track switch; disconnect the switch if not in use.
rows.zh: 初始化异常：检测到变轨器在线但耗材未通过。请检查 AMS 与变轨器间的特氟龙管连接；如无需使用变轨器，请断开其与打印机的连接。

rows.en: Abnormal movement detected on the IN-A side of the Filament Track Switch. This may be caused by debris obstruction, a loose cable, or a damaged coil. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-A 侧动作异常，可能是异物卡住或该侧排线松动、线圈损坏，请参考Wiki排故。

rows.en: Abnormal switching detection sensor detected on the IN-A side of the Filament Track Switch. The cable on this side may be loose. Please reconnect or replace the sensor and try again.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-A 侧切换检测传感器异常，可能该侧排线松动，请重新插拔或更换传感器后重试。

rows.en: Abnormal switching detection sensor detected on the IN-B side of the Filament Track Switch. The cable on this side may be loose. Please reconnect or replace the sensor and try again.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-B 侧切换检测传感器异常，可能该侧排线松动，请重新插拔或更换传感器后重试。

rows.en: Abnormal feed detection sensor detected on the IN-A side of the Filament Track Switch. The cable on this side may be loose. Please reconnect or replace the sensor and try again.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-A 侧进料检测传感器异常，可能该侧排线松动，请重新插拔或更换传感器后重试。

rows.en: Abnormal feed detection sensor detected on the IN-B side of the Filament Track Switch. The cable on this side may be loose. Please reconnect or replace the sensor and try again.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-B 侧进料检测传感器异常，可能该侧排线松动，请重新插拔或更换后重试。

rows.en: Abnormal coil resistance detected on the IN-A side of the Filament Track Switch. Please refer to the Wiki to replace the coil assembly.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-A 侧线圈电阻异常，请参考Wiki更换线圈组件。

rows.en: Abnormal coil resistance detected on the IN-B side of the Filament Track Switch. Please refer to the Wiki to replace the coil assembly.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-B 侧线圈电阻异常，请参考Wiki更换线圈组件。

rows.en: Abnormal movement detected on the IN-B side of the Filament Track Switch. This may be caused by debris obstruction, a loose cable, or a damaged coil. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 检测到耗材变轨器 IN-B 侧动作异常，可能是异物卡住或该侧排线松动、线圈损坏，请参考Wiki排故。

rows.en: AMS A The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS A排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS A The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS A exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS A 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS 主板。

rows.en: AMS A The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS A排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS A排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS A The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS A exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS A 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS 主板。

rows.en: AMS A The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS A排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS A The cooling fan of heater 1 is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器1散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS A The cooling fan speed of heater 1 is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器1散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: The AMS A heater 1 cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器1散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS A The cooling fan of heater 2 is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器2散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS A The cooling fan speed of heater 2 is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器2散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: The AMS A heater 2 cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器2散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS A The temperature sensor of heater 1 is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器1温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor 1 on the AMS A heater has malfunctioned, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS A 加热器 1 的温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS A The temperature sensor of heater 2 is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS A加热器2温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor 2 on the AMS A heater has malfunctioned, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS A 加热器 2 的温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS A The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS A烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS A Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS A不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS A Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS A环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS A The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS A 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS A chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS A 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS A The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS A 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS A The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS A 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: Filament and hotend matching failed. Please verify that the hotend in the hotend rack slot 1 is correctly installed.
rows.zh: 耗材与热端匹配失败，请检查热端挂架槽位1处热端是否正确安装。

rows.en: Filament and hotend matching failed. Please verify that the hotend in the hotend rack slot 2 is correctly installed.
rows.zh: 耗材与热端匹配失败，请检查热端挂架槽位2处热端是否正确安装。

rows.en: Filament and hotend matching failed. Please verify that the hotend in the hotend rack slot 3 is correctly installed.
rows.zh: 耗材与热端匹配失败，请检查热端挂架槽位3处热端是否正确安装。

rows.en: Filament and hotend matching failed. Please verify that the hotend in the hotend rack slot 4 is correctly installed.
rows.zh: 耗材与热端匹配失败，请检查热端挂架槽位4处热端是否正确安装。

rows.en: Filament and hotend matching failed. Please verify that the hotend in the hotend rack slot 5 is correctly installed.
rows.zh: 耗材与热端匹配失败，请检查热端挂架槽位5处热端是否正确安装。

rows.en: Filament and hotend matching failed. Please verify that the hotend in the hotend rack slot 6 is correctly installed.
rows.zh: 耗材与热端匹配失败，请检查热端挂架槽位6处热端是否正确安装。

rows.en: The AMS B assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS B 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS B assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS B assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS B The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS B The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机校准参数错误，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: The AMS B assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS B The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS B The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS B The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS B The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS B The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS B The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS B助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS B Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS B The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS B里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS B filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS B 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS B slot 1 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机1打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS B slot 1 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机1扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS B slot 1 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机1过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS B The brushed motor 1 has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机1无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: The AMS B slot 2 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机2打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS B slot 2 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机2扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS B slot 2 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机2过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS B The brushed motor 2 has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机2无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: The AMS B slot 3 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS B有刷电机3打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS B slot 4. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.

rows.zh: 读取AMS B槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是进退料过程卡住导致RFID标签无法转动，请拔出耗材重试。

rows.zh: AMS B 槽 4 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.zh: AMS B 槽 4 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.zh: AMS B 槽 4 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.zh: AMS B 槽 4 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS B slot 4 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.

rows.en: AMS B slot 4 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.

rows.zh: AMS B 槽 4 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS B slot 4 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS B 槽 4 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS B slot 4 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS B 槽 4 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS B slot 4 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.

rows.en: AMS B slot 4 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
