rows.zh: AMS B槽3的耗材送出失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the AMS B Slot 4 filament from the extruder. Possible cause: clogged extruder or broken filament inside the extruder.
rows.zh: AMS B槽4的耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.en: Failed to feed the AMS B Slot 4 filament into the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B槽4的耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.en: Failed to extrude the filament. Possible cause: extruder or nozzle clog.
rows.zh: 耗材挤出异常，可能是挤出机或喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: Failed to pull back the AMS B Slot 4 filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B槽4的耗材从工具头退回失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.en: Failed to feed the AMS B Slot 4 filament. Please trim the end of the filament and check if the spool is stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B槽4的耗材送出失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

rows.en: AMS B Heater 1, heater malfunction or abnormal current sensor detected.
rows.zh: AMS B 加热器 1 检测到加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS B The heater 1 is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器1离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS B The heater 1 is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器1短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS B The heater 1 is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器1异常发热。

rows.en: AMS B Heater 2, heater malfunction or abnormal current sensor detected.
rows.zh: AMS B 加热器 2 检测到加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS B The heater 2 is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器2离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS B The heater 2 is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器2短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS B The heater 2 is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器2异常发热。

rows.en: AMS B is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS B与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS B The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS B排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS B The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS B排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS B exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS B 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS 主板。

rows.en: AMS B The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS B排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS B The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS B排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS B The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS B排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS B exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS B 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS 主板。

rows.en: AMS B The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS B排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS B The cooling fan of heater 1 is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器1散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS B The cooling fan speed of heater 1 is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器1散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: The AMS B heater 1 cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器1散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS B The cooling fan of heater 2 is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器2散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS B The cooling fan speed of heater 2 is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器2散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: The AMS B heater 2 cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器2散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS B The temperature sensor of heater 1 is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器1温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor 1 on the AMS B heater has malfunctioned, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS B 加热器 1 的温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS B The temperature sensor of heater 2 is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS B加热器2温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor 2 on the AMS B heater has malfunctioned, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS B 加热器 2 的温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS B The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS B烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS B Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS B不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS B Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS B环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS B The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS B 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS B chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS B 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS B The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS B 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS B The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS B 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS C assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS C 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS C assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS C assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS C The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS C The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机校准参数错误，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: The AMS C assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS C 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS C The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS C The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS C The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS C The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS C The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS C The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS C助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS C Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS C The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS C里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS C filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS C 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 1 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机1打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 1 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机1扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 1 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机1过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS C The brushed motor 1 has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机1无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 2 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机2打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 2 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机2扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 2 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机2过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS C The brushed motor 2 has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机2无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 3 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机3打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 3 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机3扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 3 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机3过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS C The brushed motor 3 has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机3无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 4 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机4打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 4 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机4扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS C slot 4 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机4过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS C The brushed motor 4 has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS C有刷电机4无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 1. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位1的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 1. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位1的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 1. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位1的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 1. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位1的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 1. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位1的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 1. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during the filament loading or unloading. Please pull out the filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位1的耗材信息失败，可能是进退料过程卡住导致RFID标签无法转动，请拔出耗材重试。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1's filament may be broken in AMS.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1耗材可能断在AMS中。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS C has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS C 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS C Slot 1 filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS C槽位1耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS C Slot 1 filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS C 槽 1 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽 1 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS C 1 槽助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS C slot 1 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS C 1 槽助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS C Slot 1 cannot be identified.
rows.zh: 无法识别 AMS C 料卷 1 的标签内容。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS C Slot 1 filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS C 槽位1耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 2. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 2. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位2的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 2. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 2. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 2. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS C槽位2的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS C slot 2. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during the filament loading or unloading. Please pull out the filament and try again.

rows.en: Laser engraving Z-axis focus calibration failed. Please check if the Laser Test Material (350g paperboard) is properly placed and its surface is clean and intact.
rows.zh: 雕刻激光校准Z轴对焦失败，请检查激光测试材料（350g卡纸）是否正确放置且表面干净完好。

rows.en: Insufficient system memory was detected, and the foreign object detection function was not working. Please restart the devices or update the firmware after the task is completed
rows.zh: 检测到系统内存不足，异物检测功能未生效。可在任务结束后重启打印机或升级最新固件以改善该问题。

rows.en: The Vision Encoder Plate is either not placed or incorrectly placed. Please ensure it is correctly positioned on the heatbed.
rows.zh: 视觉编码器板未放置或放置不当，请确认已经在热床上正确放置。

rows.en: Your nozzle seems to be covered with jammed or clogged material.
rows.zh: 检测到可能发生了裹头。

rows.en: Foreign object detection is not working, and images cannot be obtained. Please check the live camera connection.
rows.zh: 异物检测未生效，无法获取图像，请检查实况摄像头连接状态。

rows.en: Purged filament may have piled up in the waste chute. Please check and clean the chute.
rows.zh: 可能发生废料堆积。请检查并清理废料槽。

rows.en: Possible first layer defects have been detected. Please check the first layer quality and decide if the job should be stopped.
rows.zh: 可能发生首层打印缺陷。请检查首层质量并决定是否停止任务。

rows.en: A possible spaghetti failure has been detected. Please check the print quality and decide whether to stop the job. Cleaning the build plate with detergent or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
rows.zh: 可能发生炒面缺陷，请检查打印质量并决定是否停止任务。使用清洗剂清洁打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

rows.en: Inspecting the first layer: please wait a moment.
rows.zh: 首层检查中，请稍候。

rows.en: Detected that the extruder may not be extruding normally. Please check and decide if printing should be stopped.
rows.zh: 检测到喷嘴可能没有正常挤出。请检查并确认是否需要停止打印。

rows.en: Possible spaghetti defects were detected. Please check the print quality and decide if the job should be stopped. Cleaning the build plate with detergent or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
rows.zh: 可能发生炒面缺陷。请检查打印质量并决定是否停止任务。使用清洗剂清洁打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

rows.en: BirdsEye Camera malfunction: please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头功能异常，请联系售后服务。

rows.en: Failed to measure material thickness due to laser module malfunction.
rows.zh: 材料厚度测量失败，激光模组功能异常。

rows.en: Failed to measure material thickness: device parameters abnormal; please setup BirdsEye Camera again.
rows.zh: 材料厚度测量失败，设备参数异常。请重新运行俯视摄像头初始化。

rows.en: Live View Camera data link is abnormal.
rows.zh: 实况摄像头数据链路异常。

rows.en: The exposure parameters of the BirdsEye Camera are not effective; please try again.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头的曝光参数设置没有生效，请重试。

rows.en: Cutting Protection Base not detected, which may lead to heatbed damage. Please place it and continue.
rows.zh: 未检测到刀切保护钢板，有损坏热床风险，请放置后继续。

rows.en: Laser Protective Insert not detected. Please place it and continue.
rows.zh: 未检测到激光保护铝板，请放置后继续。

rows.en: Quick-release Lever is not locked. Please push it down to secure.
rows.zh: 快拆锁扣未锁定，请向下扣紧。

rows.en: The visual marker on the heatbed is damaged, please contact after-sales.
rows.zh: 热床视觉标志损坏，请联系售后。

rows.en: The device malfunctioned; please restart.
rows.zh: 设备故障，请重启机器。

rows.en: Cutting Platform not detected. Please place the required mat for the task and continue.
rows.zh: 未检测到粘性刀切粘板，请放置任务需要的粘板后继续。

rows.en: The Laser Platform is not properly aligned. Please ensure all four corners are aligned with the heatbed.
rows.zh: 激光工作底板偏移，请确保底板的四角与热床对齐。

rows.en: The type of platform is not supported for this task. Please use the correct platform to continue.
rows.zh: 垫板类型不支持该任务，请使用正确的垫板继续任务。

rows.en: BirdsEye Camera is setting up. Please clear all objects and remove the mat. Make sure the marker is not obstructed. Meanwhile, clean both the BirdsEye Camera and Toolhead Camera, and remove any foreign objects blocking their view.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头正在初始化，请清空热床上的所有物体并拿开垫板。确保热床标记不被遮挡。同时，请清理俯视摄像头及工具头摄像头，并移除可能遮挡摄像头的异物。

rows.en: Material not detected. Please confirm placement and continue.
rows.zh: 未检测到制作材料，请确认放置材料后继续。

rows.en: The visual marker was not detected during PrintThenCut; please re-paste the material to the correct position. Meanwhile, please clean the Toolhead Camera to prevent contamination and remove any objects that may obstruct its view.
rows.zh: 打印后刀切未检测到视觉标志，请重新粘贴材料。可查阅wiki获得详细解决方案。

rows.en: Blade offset calibration failed. Run cutting module offset calibration in the Toolbox. If the problem persists, check for blade tip wear.
rows.zh: 模切刀偏移校准失败。请执行工具箱中的刀切模组偏移校准；若问题仍存在，请检查模切刀刀尖是否磨损。

rows.en: The Birdseye Camera is installed offset. Please refer to the Wiki to reinstall it.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头安装偏移，请参照Wiki重新进行安装

rows.en: Thickness measurement failed, the Toolhead Camera was unable to detect the material surface.
rows.zh: 测厚失败，工具头摄像头没有识别到材料表面。

rows.en: Liveview Camera initialization failed, and some AI functions such as Spaghetti Detection will be disabled. Please restart the printer. If the problem persists, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 实况摄像头初始化失败，炒面检测等部分AI功能会失效。请重启打印机，若仍遇到此问题，请联系售后。

rows.en: The Laser or Cutting module has not been calibrated. Please calibrate it on the printer first.
rows.zh: 激光或刀切模块未校准，请先在打印机上校准。

rows.en: The liveview camera is not functioning properly. Please restart the machine and try again.
rows.zh: 实况相机工作异常，请重启机器。

rows.en: The liveview camera may be dirty or obstructed. Please check and clean it.
rows.zh: 实况相机脏污或被遮挡，请检查并清理。

rows.en: The BirdsEye Camera is initializing. Please make sure the markers on the cutting mat are not obstructed, clean both the BirdsEye Camera and the Toolhead Camera, and remove any foreign objects that may block the cameras.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头正在初始化，请确保刀切垫板上的标记未被遮挡，并清洁俯视摄像头和工具头摄像头，移除任何可能遮挡摄像头视野的异物。

rows.en: Measurement failed because the object is not properly clamped on the Rotary Attachment, the object diameter is too small, or the claws are positioned above the object. Please place and secure the object correctly on the Rotary Attachment.
rows.zh: 旋转轴未正确夹持物体、物体直径过小或夹爪位于物体上方，导致无法测量，请将物体正确放置并夹持在旋转轴上。

rows.en: Capture image failed. Please initiate the measurement again.
rows.zh: 拍照测量失败，请重新发起测量。

rows.en:
The rotary attachment is installed, so Measure Thickness
 and Curved Surface Measurement are unavailable. Please remove the rotary attachment first, then try again.
rows.zh: 设备已装载旋转组件，无法使用平面测厚、曲面测量等功能。请先拆卸旋转组件，然后重新尝试。

rows.en: The Cutting blade offset calibration failed. This may affect the cutting accuracy. Please refer to the Wiki to check if the blade tip is worn.
rows.zh: 模切刀偏移校准失败，本次切割可能存在误差。请检查切割刀尖是否已磨损。可查阅wiki获得详细解决方案。

rows.en: The BirdsEye Camera position is detected to be offset. To ensure engraving accuracy, it is recommended to rerun the BirdsEye Camera Setup.
rows.zh: 检测到俯视摄像头位置发生偏移，为保证雕刻位置精度，建议重新运行俯视摄像头初始化。

rows.en: To improve flame detection accuracy, the right chamber light has been automatically turned off.
rows.zh: 为提高火焰检测精度，设备已自动关闭右侧腔体照明灯。

rows.en: The Cutting Module offset calibration failed, which may result in inaccurate cuts. Please ensure the 80g white printer paper (letter paper thickness) is properly positioned; if the blade tip is worn, replace it. If the issue persists after checking, restart the device and try again.
rows.zh: 刀切模组偏移校准失败，切割可能存在误差。请先确认已正确放置 80g 打印纸（相当于 A4 纸厚度）；如切割刀尖已磨损，请更换。若检查正常后问题仍存在，请重启设备后再次尝试。

rows.en: The AMS lite Slot 1 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS lite 有刷电机 1 打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS lite Slot 1 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS lite 有刷电机 1 扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS lite Slot 1 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS lite 有刷电机 1 过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.zh: AMS lite 槽位 1 耗材用完，请放置新料。

rows.zh: AMS lite 槽位 1 为空，需放置耗材。

rows.zh: AMS lite 槽位 1 耗材可能断在料管中。

rows.zh: AMS lite 槽位 1 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.zh: AMS lite 槽位 1 耗材挤出异常，可能存在堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.zh: AMS lite RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID线圈断或者射频硬件电路损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of an encryption chip failure in AMS lite.
rows.zh: AMS lite 加密芯片损坏，无法读取RFID。

rows.zh: AMS lite 料卷标签 1 损坏或非法，可能是料卷标签坏了或者用户使用了假的标签。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS lite Slot 1 cannot be identified.
rows.zh: 无法识别AMS lite 料卷 1 的标签内容。

rows.zh: AMS lite 槽位 1 由于结构问题导致识别RFID失败。

rows.zh: 切料传感器异常，请检查连接器是否插好。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT A. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT A 的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read  filament information from AMS-HT A. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during filament loading or unloading. Please remove the filament and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT A has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT A feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT A feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT A filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT A filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT A 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT A feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT A pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT A feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT A feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT A is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT A failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT A feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT A filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT A door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT A front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT A uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT A 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT A will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT A 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT A RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT A is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT A RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT A Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: The filament buffer signal is abnormal; the spring may be stuck, or the filament may be tangled.
rows.zh: 缓冲区位置信号异常，可能缓冲区弹簧卡住或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: The filament cutter sensor is malfunctioning; please check whether the connector is properly plugged in.
rows.zh: 切料传感器异常。请检查连接器是否正确插入。

rows.en: The filament cutter's cutting distance is too large. The XY motor may lose steps.
rows.zh: 切刀刀柄行程异常，可能电机丢步或XY未回零。

rows.en: The filament cutter handle has not been released. The handle or blade may be jammed, or there could be an issue with the filament sensor connection.
rows.zh: 切刀刀柄未松开，刀柄或刀片可能被卡住，或耗材霍尔接线异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT A communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT A is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.en: The AMS is disabled; please load filament from the spool holder.
rows.zh: AMS已禁用，请从料盘支架加载耗材。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

variants.094: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.20P: The PTFE tube connection between the toolhead and buffer is incorrect. Please ensure the upper port of the buffer is connected to the left extruder, and the lower port is connected to the right extruder.
variants.239: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.31B: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.

rows.en: AMS-HT A was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS-HT A离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS-HT A and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: A new AMS-HT detected. Please set it up to check which extruder the AMS-HT is connected to.
rows.zh: 检测到新AMS-HT接入，需要进行一次初始化，检查AMS-HT连接到了哪一侧挤出机。

rows.en: AMS-HT A is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS-HT A motor was overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 电机过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.zh: 耗材挤出异常，可能是挤出机或喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS-HT. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: 耗材从工具头退回AMS-HT失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

variants.00M: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS-HT. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

variants.31B: Failed to pull back the AMS-HT A filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

rows.en: Failed to feed the filament outside the AMS-HT. Please clip the end of the filament flat and check to see if the spool is stuck.
rows.zh: 耗材送出AMS-HT失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

rows.en: Timeout purging old filament. Possible cause: filament stuck or the extruder/nozzle clog.
rows.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，可能是耗材卡住或挤出机/喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: AMS-HT filament ran out. Please put a new filament into the same slot in AMS and resume.
rows.zh: AMS-HT耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file.
rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT A heater malfunction or the current sensor is abnormal.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The heater is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT A heater is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The heater is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器异常发热。

rows.en: AMS-HT A is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT A exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT A exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A heater cooling fan is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The heater cooling fan speed is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT A heater cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS-HT A heater temperature sensor is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor on the AMS-HT A heater was malfunction, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 加热器温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS-HT A Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT A Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT A chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS-HT A The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT A 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull the filament out of the feed inlet and restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机校准参数错误。请从进料口拉出耗材并重启 AMS。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS-HT B Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B有刷电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 有刷电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B有刷电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT B brushed motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B有刷电机无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT B. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT B 的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT B. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT B 的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT B. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT B 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read filament information from AMS-HT B. The RFID tag may be damaged, or the filament is positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please trim 5cm of the filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT B 耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏，或耗材位于RFID检测装置边缘。请剪除5cm耗材后重试。

rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT B 的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read  filament information from AMS-HT B. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during filament loading or unloading. Please remove the filament and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT B has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT B feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT B feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT B filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT B filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT B 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT B feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT B pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT B feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT B feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT B is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT B failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT B feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT B filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT B door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT B front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT B uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT B 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT B will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT B 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT B is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT B RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT B Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT B communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT B is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

rows.zh: AMS-HT耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file.
rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT B heater malfunction or the current sensor is abnormal.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The heater is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT B heater is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The heater is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器异常发热。

rows.en: AMS-HT B is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT B exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT B exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B heater cooling fan is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The heater cooling fan speed is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT B heater cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS-HT B heater temperature sensor is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor on the AMS-HT B heater was malfunction, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 加热器温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS-HT B Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT B Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT B chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS-HT B The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT B 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull the filament out of the feed inlet and restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机校准参数错误。请从进料口拉出耗材并重启 AMS。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS-HT C Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C有刷电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 有刷电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C有刷电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT C brushed motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C有刷电机无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT C 的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT C 的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT C 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged, or the filament is positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please trim 5cm of the filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT C 耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏，或耗材位于RFID检测装置边缘。请剪除5cm耗材后重试。

variants.00M: Failed to read filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged, or the filament is positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please trim 5cm of the filament and try again.
variants.01P: Failed to read filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged, or the filament is positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please trim 5cm of the filament and try again.
variants.03W: Failed to read filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged, or the filament is positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please trim 5cm of the filament and try again.
variants.093: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
variants.094: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
variants.20P: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
variants.22E: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
variants.239: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
variants.26A: Failed to read filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged, or the filament is positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please trim 5cm of the filament and try again.
variants.31B: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT C. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT C 的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read  filament information from AMS-HT C. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during filament loading or unloading. Please remove the filament and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT C has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT C feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT C feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT C filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT C filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT C 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT C feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT C pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT C feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT C feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT C is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT C failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT C feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT C filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT C door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT C front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT C uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT C 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT C will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT C 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT C is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT C RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT C Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT C communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT C is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

variants.094: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.20P: The PTFE tube connection between the toolhead and buffer is incorrect. Please ensure the upper port of the buffer is connected to the left extruder, and the lower port is connected to the right extruder.
variants.239: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.31B: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.

rows.en: AMS-HT C was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS-HT C离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS-HT C and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: AMS-HT C is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS-HT C motor was overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 电机过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT C heater malfunction or the current sensor is abnormal.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The heater is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT C heater is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The heater is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器异常发热。

rows.en: AMS-HT C is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT C exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT C exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C heater cooling fan is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The heater cooling fan speed is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT C heater cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS-HT C heater temperature sensor is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor on the AMS-HT C heater was malfunction, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 加热器温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS-HT C Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT C Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT C chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS-HT C The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull the filament out of the feed inlet and restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机校准参数错误。请从进料口拉出耗材并重启 AMS。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS-HT D Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D有刷电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 有刷电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D有刷电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT D brushed motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D有刷电机无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT D. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT D 的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT D. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT D 的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT D. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT D 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read filament information from AMS-HT D. The RFID tag may be damaged, or the filament is positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please trim 5cm of the filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT D 耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏，或耗材位于RFID检测装置边缘。请剪除5cm耗材后重试。
