rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT D has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT D feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT D feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT D filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT D filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT D 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT D feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT D pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT D feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT D feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT D is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT D failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT D feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT D filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT D door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT D front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT D uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT D 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT D will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT D 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT D is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT D RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT D Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT D communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT D is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

variants.094: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.20P: The PTFE tube connection between the toolhead and buffer is incorrect. Please ensure the upper port of the buffer is connected to the left extruder, and the lower port is connected to the right extruder.
variants.239: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.31B: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.

rows.en: AMS-HT D was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS-HT D离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS-HT D and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: AMS-HT D is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS-HT D motor was overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 电机过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

variants.31B: Failed to pull out the AMS-HT D filament from the extruder. Possible cause: clogged extruder or broken filament inside the extruder.

rows.zh: 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

variants.31B: Failed to feed the AMS-HT D filament into the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

rows.en: Failed to extrude the filament. Possible cause: extruder or nozzle clog.
rows.zh: 耗材挤出异常，可能是挤出机或喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS-HT. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: 耗材从工具头退回AMS-HT失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

variants.00M: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS-HT. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
variants.01P: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS-HT. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
variants.03W: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS-HT. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
variants.093: Failed to pull back the AMS-HT D filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
variants.094: Failed to pull back the AMS-HT D filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
variants.20P: Failed to pull back the AMS-HT D filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

variants.31B: Failed to pull back the AMS-HT D filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

rows.en: Failed to feed the filament outside the AMS-HT. Please clip the end of the filament flat and check to see if the spool is stuck.
rows.zh: 耗材送出AMS-HT失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

variants.00M: Failed to feed the filament outside the AMS-HT. Please clip the end of the filament flat and check to see if the spool is stuck.
variants.01P: Failed to feed the filament outside the AMS-HT. Please clip the end of the filament flat and check to see if the spool is stuck.

variants.094: Failed to feed the AMS-HT D filament. Please trim the end of the filament and check if the spool is stuck.

rows.en: Timeout purging old filament. Possible cause: filament stuck or the extruder/nozzle clog.
rows.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，可能是耗材卡住或挤出机/喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: AMS-HT filament ran out. Please put a new filament into the same slot in AMS and resume.
rows.zh: AMS-HT耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file.
rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT D heater malfunction or the current sensor is abnormal.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The heater is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT D heater is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The heater is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器异常发热。

rows.en: AMS-HT D is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT D exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT D exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D heater cooling fan is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The heater cooling fan speed is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT D heater cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS-HT D heater temperature sensor is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor on the AMS-HT D heater was malfunction, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 加热器温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS-HT D Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT D Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT D chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS-HT D The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull the filament out of the feed inlet and restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机校准参数错误。请从进料口拉出耗材并重启 AMS。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS-HT E Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E有刷电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 有刷电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E有刷电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT E brushed motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E有刷电机无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT E. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT E 的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT E. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT E 的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT E. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT E 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT E. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT E 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT E. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT E 的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read  filament information from AMS-HT E. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during filament loading or unloading. Please remove the filament and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT E has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT E feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT E feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT E filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT E filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT E 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT E feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT E pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT E feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT E feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT E is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT E failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT E feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT E filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT E door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT E front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT E uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT E 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT E will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT E 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT E is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT E RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT E Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT E communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

variants.094: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.20P: The PTFE tube connection between the toolhead and buffer is incorrect. Please ensure the upper port of the buffer is connected to the left extruder, and the lower port is connected to the right extruder.
variants.239: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.31B: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.

rows.en: AMS-HT E was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS-HT E离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS-HT E and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS-HT E motor was overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 电机过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.en: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS-HT. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.
rows.zh: 耗材从工具头退回AMS-HT失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

variants.31B: Failed to pull back the AMS-HT E filament from the Toolhead. Possible cause: filament or spool stuck.

rows.zh: 耗材送出AMS-HT失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

rows.en: Timeout purging old filament. Possible cause: filament stuck or the extruder/nozzle clog.
rows.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，可能是耗材卡住或挤出机/喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: AMS-HT filament ran out. Please put a new filament into the same slot in AMS and resume.
rows.zh: AMS-HT耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file.
rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT E heater malfunction or the current sensor is abnormal.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The heater is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT E heater is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The heater is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器异常发热。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT E exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT E exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E heater cooling fan is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The heater cooling fan speed is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT E heater cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS-HT E heater temperature sensor is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor on the AMS-HT E heater was malfunction, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 加热器温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS-HT E Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT E Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT E chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS-HT E The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull the filament out of the feed inlet and restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机校准参数错误。请从进料口拉出耗材并重启 AMS。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS-HT F Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F有刷电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 有刷电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F有刷电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT F brushed motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F有刷电机无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT F. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT F 的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT F. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT F 的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT F. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT F 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT F. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT F 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT F. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT F 的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read  filament information from AMS-HT F. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during filament loading or unloading. Please remove the filament and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT F has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT F feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT F feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT F filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT F filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT F 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT F feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT F pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT F feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT F feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT F is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT F failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT F feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT F filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT F door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT F front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT F uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT F 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT F will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT F 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT F is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT F RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT F Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT F communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT F is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

variants.094: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.20P: The PTFE tube connection between the toolhead and buffer is incorrect. Please ensure the upper port of the buffer is connected to the left extruder, and the lower port is connected to the right extruder.

variants.31B: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.

rows.en: AMS-HT F was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS-HT F离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS-HT F and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: AMS-HT F is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS-HT F motor was overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 电机过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.zh: 耗材从工具头退回AMS-HT失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

rows.zh: 耗材送出AMS-HT失败，请剪平耗材端口、检查料盘是否卡住。

rows.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，可能是耗材卡住或挤出机/喷嘴堵塞。

rows.en: AMS-HT filament ran out. Please put a new filament into the same slot in AMS and resume.
rows.zh: AMS-HT耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file.
rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT F heater malfunction or the current sensor is abnormal.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The heater is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT F heater is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The heater is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器异常发热。

rows.en: AMS-HT F is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT F exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT F exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F heater cooling fan is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The heater cooling fan speed is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT F heater cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS-HT F heater temperature sensor is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor on the AMS-HT F heater was malfunction, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 加热器温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS-HT F Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT F Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT F chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS-HT F The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull the filament out of the feed inlet and restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机校准参数错误。请从进料口拉出耗材并重启 AMS。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS-HT G Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G有刷电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 有刷电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G有刷电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT G brushed motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G有刷电机无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT G. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT G 的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT G. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT G 的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT G. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT G 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT G. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT G 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT G. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT G 的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read  filament information from AMS-HT G. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during filament loading or unloading. Please remove the filament and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT G has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT G feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT G feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT G filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT G filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT G 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT G feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT G pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT G feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT G feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT G is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT G failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT G feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT G filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT G door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT G front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT G uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT G 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT G will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT G 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT G is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT G RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT G Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT G communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT G is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

rows.en: AMS-HT G was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS-HT G离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS-HT G and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: AMS-HT G is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS-HT G motor was overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 电机过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.zh: AMS-HT耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败。

rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器故障或电流传感器异常。

rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT G heater is short-circuited, which may be due to a wiring short or heater damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器短路,可能接线短路或加热器损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The heater is heating abnormally.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器异常发热。

rows.en: AMS-HT G is not correctly bound to the filament track switch. Please run AMS setup again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G与耗材变轨器绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The coil resistance of exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G排气风门1线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The exhaust valve 1 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G排气风门1开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT G exhaust valve 1 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 排气风门 1 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The operation of the exhaust valve 1 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G排气风门1动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The coil resistance of exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to abnormal wiring or damage.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G排气风门2线圈电阻异常，可能是接线异常或者损坏。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The exhaust valve 2 is not connected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G排气风门2开路,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: The current sensor of AMS-HT G exhaust valve 2 is abnormal; please get in touch with customer support to replace the AMS-HT mainboard.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 排气风门 2 电流传感器异常，请联系客服更换 AMS-HT 主板。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The operation of the exhaust valve 2 is abnormal, which may be due to excessive resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G排气风门2动作异常,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G heater cooling fan is blocked, which may be due to the fan being stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器散热风扇堵转,可能是风扇被异物卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The heater cooling fan speed is too low, which could be due to excessive fan resistance.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器散热风扇转速低,可能是阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT G heater cooling fan cannot start because the power adapter is not connected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器散热风扇无法启动，因为电源适配器未接。

rows.en: AMS-HT G heater temperature sensor is offline, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器温度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Temperature sensor on the AMS-HT G heater was malfunction, resulting in abnormal temperature readings.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 加热器温度传感器故障，测温异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The drying process may experience thermal runaway. Please turn off the AMS power supply.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G烘干可能发生热失控，请关闭AMS电源。

rows.en: AMS-HT G Unable to start drying; please pull out the filament from filament hub and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G不能发起烘干，请将耗材退出五通组件，然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT G Environmental temperature is too low, which will affect the drying capability.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G环境温度过低，烘干效果会受影响。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The temperature control error is too large, which may be due to the lid being open or an abnormality with the heater.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 温控误差过大，可能是盖子打开或者加热器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT G chamber temperature is too high; auxiliary feeding or RFID reading is currently not allowed.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 腔温较高，现在不能辅助上料或读RFID。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The power adapter voltage is too low, which may result in insufficient drying temperature. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 电源适配器电压过低，可能导致烘干温度偏低，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: AMS-HT G The power adapter voltage is too high, which may damage the heater circuit. Please replace the power adapter.
rows.zh: AMS-HT G 电源适配器电压过高，可能导致加热器电路损坏，请更换电源适配器。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H assist motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be worn down, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H assist motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器故障。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H assist motor speed control is malfunctioning. The speed sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机转速控制异常，可能是转速传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The current sensor of assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H助力电机电流传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The assist motor calibration parameter error. Please pull the filament out of the feed inlet and restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机校准参数错误。请从进料口拉出耗材并重启 AMS。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H assist motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The assist motor three-phase wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H助力电机三相线未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The assist motor encoder wires are not connected. The assist motor connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H助力电机编码器未接,可能是电机排线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The assist motor phase winding has an open circuit. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H助力电机相绕组开路,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The assist motor has unbalanced tree-phase resistaance. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H助力电机三相电阻不平衡,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The assist motor resistance is abnormal. The assist motor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H助力电机电阻异常,可能是电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The motor assist parameter is lost. Please pull out the filament from the filament hub and then restart the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H助力电机参数丢失，请将耗材拉出五通，然后重启AMS。

rows.en: AMS-HT H Filament speed and length error: The filament odometry may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材速度与长度计算错误，可能是里程轮传感器故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The odometer has no signal. The odometer connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H里程轮无信号,可能是里程轮线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament odometer speed signal is abnormal. If you hear unusual noises or the filament fails to unload from the Auxiliary Extruder, please replace the filament odometer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 里程轮速度信号异常，若辅助挤出机退料时有异响或退料失败，请更换里程轮。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H有刷电机打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 有刷电机扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H有刷电机过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

rows.en: AMS-HT H brushed motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H有刷电机无响应,可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT H. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT H 的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT H. A third party RFID tag was detected.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT H 的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT H. The RFID tag may be damaged.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT H 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT H. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT H 的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT H. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
rows.zh: 读取AMS-HT H 的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

rows.en: Failed to read  filament information from AMS-HT H. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during filament loading or unloading. Please remove the filament and try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材信息读取失败，可能由进退料卡滞导致 RFID 标签无法转动，请拔出耗材后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament is empty; please insert a new filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材为空，请插入耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament may be broken.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament may be broken in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材可能断在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

rows.en: AMS-HT H has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

rows.en: AMS-HT H feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT H feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT H filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

rows.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT H filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
rows.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT H 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT H feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材送出AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT H pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材退回AMS超时。

rows.en: AMS-HT H feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

rows.en: AMS-HT H feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

rows.en: The tube inside the AMS-HT H is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

rows.en: AMS-HT H failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 的耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

rows.en: AMS-HT H feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT H assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

rows.en: AMS-HT H filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

rows.en: AMS-HT H door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

rows.en: AMS-HT H front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

rows.en: AMS-HT H uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
rows.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT H 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

rows.en: The induction hotend is heating up, and the drying power of AMS-HT H will be reduced. Please connect the power adapter or wait until the hotend finishes heating.
rows.zh: 感应热端加热中，AMS-HT H 的烘干功率将被降低，请连接 AMS 电源适配器或等待热端加热完成。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H RFID 1 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT H is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The AMS-HT H RFID 2 board has an error.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

rows.en: Encryption chip failure
rows.zh: 加密芯片损坏。

rows.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
rows.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

rows.en: The temperature and humidity sensor has an error. The chip may be faulty.
rows.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

rows.en: AMS-HT H The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

rows.en: AMS-HT H Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

rows.en: AMS-HT H communication is abnormal; please check the connection cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 通信异常，请检查AMS的连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable..
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 已断开连接，请拔插连接线缆。

rows.en: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
rows.zh: 工具头与缓冲器间的特氟龙管连接顺序错误，请保持：缓冲器上部接右挤出机，下部接左挤出机。

variants.20P: The PTFE tube connection between the toolhead and buffer is incorrect. Please ensure the upper port of the buffer is connected to the left extruder, and the lower port is connected to the right extruder.
variants.239: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.
variants.31B: The PTFE tube is incorrectly connected between the toolhead and the buffer. Please connect the buffer's top to the right extruder and the bottom to the left extruder.

rows.en: AMS-HT H was detected offline during the AMS initialization process.
rows.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS-HT H离线。

rows.en: The binding between AMS-HT H and the extruder is incorrect. Please run the AMS Setup.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

rows.en: Please connect the PTFE tube along the correct path, from the AMS through the buffer and then to the toolhead. Bypassing the buffer may cause the AMS to fail to feed filament properly.
rows.zh: 请将 PTFE 料管按正确路径连接，从 AMS 经过缓冲器再连接至工具头。绕过缓冲器连接将导致 AMS 无法正常送料。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is undergoing dry cooling; please wait for it to cool down before operating.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

rows.en: AMS-HT H motor was overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 电机过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

rows.en: Failed to extrude the filament. Possible cause: extruder or nozzle clog.
