variants.239: The Toolhead Lifting Motor position hall sensor is short-circuited; please check if the Hall sensor is malfunctioning.
variants.31B: The Toolhead Lifting Motor position hall sensor is short-circuited; please check if the Hall sensor is malfunctioning.

rows.en: The extruder's switching limit angle has drifted significantly. Please check if the flow blocker is jammed or if filament is stuck in the toolhead.
rows.zh: 挤出机切换限位角度发生较大偏移，请检查堵嘴片是否卡住或是否有耗材卡在工具头内。

rows.en: The TH board disconnected during the extruder switching process. Please check if the connecting cable is loose.
rows.zh: 挤出机切换过程中TH板断联，请检查连接排线是否松动。

rows.en: The lifting action is abnormal during the extruder switch. Please check whether the flow blocker is stuck or there is filament stuck in the toolhead.
rows.zh: 挤出机切换过程中升降动作异常，请检查堵嘴片是否卡住或是否有耗材卡在工具头内。

rows.en: The position of left hotend is abnormal during printing. Please check whether the flow blocker scratches the printed model.
rows.zh: 打印过程中左热端位置异常，请检查堵嘴片是否剐蹭打印模型。

variants.094: The position of left hotend is abnormal during printing. Please check whether the flow blocker scratches the printed model.
variants.20P: Extruder switch lever failed to hit the rod, possibly due to the XY motor losing step. Please check for any obstructions blocking the toolhead movement, such as a PTFE tube.
variants.239: The position of left hotend is abnormal during printing. Please check whether the flow blocker scratches the printed model.
variants.31B: The position of left hotend is abnormal during printing. Please check whether the flow blocker scratches the printed model.

rows.en: The deviation in the positioning calibration value of the extruder is too large; please recalibrate.
rows.zh: 挤出机位置校准数值偏差过大，请重新校准。

rows.en: Abnormal auxiliary extruder hotend position detected. Check for nozzle wiper contact with the printed model or a pinched filament tube above the toolhead.
rows.zh: 检测到辅助挤出机热端位置异常。请检查堵嘴片是否剐蹭打印模型，或者工具头上方料管是否被挤压。

rows.en: The extruder switching motor is working abnormally. Please check whether the connecting cable is loose.
rows.zh: 挤出切换电机工作异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

rows.en: The position hall sensor of the Extruder Switching Motor has an open circuit. Please check whether the connecting cable is loose.
rows.zh: 挤出切换电机位置霍尔传感器断路，请检查连接排线是否松动。

rows.en: The hall signal of the Extruder Switching Motor is abnormal, possibly due to internal communication failure in the Toolhead module.
rows.zh: 挤出切换电机位置霍尔信号异常，可能工具头模块内部通信故障。

rows.en: The position hall sensor of the Extruder Switching Motor has a short circuit; please check if the Hall sensor is malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 挤出切换电机位置霍尔传感器短路，请检查霍尔传感器是否异常。

rows.en: The TH board disconnected during the extruder switching process. Please check if the connecting cable is loose.
rows.zh: 挤出机切换过程中TH板断联，请检查连接排线是否松动。

rows.en: The extruder switching action is abnormal. Please check whether there is something stuck in the toolhead.
rows.zh: 挤出切换动作异常，请检查是否有异物卡在工具头内。

rows.en: Open circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 1 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架槽位 1 位置霍尔传感器断路，请参照Wiki排查。

rows.en: Short circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 1 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架槽位 1 位置霍尔传感器短路，请参照Wiki排查。

rows.en: Error fetching/nesting the hotend in rack slot 1. Ensure the hotend holder has no hotend installed, the corresponding rack slot contains a hotend, and manually move the toolhead to the machine center before continuing.
rows.zh: 取放挂架槽位 1 热端时发生异常，请保证感应热端固定槽上无热端，对应挂架槽位上有热端，并手动将工具头移动到机器中央后再继续。

rows.en: Error fetching/nesting the hotend in rack slot 1. Ensure the hotend holder has a hotend installed, the corresponding rack slot is empty, and manually move the toolhead to the machine center before continuing.
rows.zh: 取放挂架槽位 1 热端时发生异常，请保证感应热端固定槽上有热端，对应挂架槽位上无热端，并手动将工具头移动到机器中央后再继续。

rows.en: Error detected before induction hotend replacement: no hotend installed in slot 1 on the rack.
rows.zh: 在更换感应热端前检测到错误，挂架位置 1 未安装热端。

rows.en: Error detected before induction hotend replacement: a hotend is already installed in slot 1 on the rack. Please remove it before continuing.
rows.zh: 在更换感应热端前检测到错误，挂架位置 1 已安装热端，请先取下该热端后再继续。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: a hotend is already installed. Please remove the existing one before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：该位置已安装热端，请先取下现有热端后再点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: no hotend detected on the toolhead. Please mount the hotend onto the toolhead before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头上未安装热端，请将热端装到工具头上后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1. Please ensure no hotend is mounted on the toolhead and that a hotend is present in slot 1 on the rack before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常，请确保工具头上未安装热端，且热端挂架 1 位置已有热端，然后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: the rack failed to detect the hotend on the toolhead. Please check whether there is any debris on the hotend heatsink surface or if the front magnet has fallen off. If not, recalibrate the induction hotend rack.
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未识别到工具头上的热端。请检查热端散热片表面是否有异物或前端磁铁是否脱落，若无异常，请重新标定感应热端挂架。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: the rack failed to detach the hotend from the toolhead. Please make sure the locking lever is in the released position.
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未能从工具头上成功取下热端，请确保锁紧拉柄已处于拉开状态。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: the hotend has dropped. Please check for excessive filament remaining at the top of the hotend, trim the residue, reinstall the hotend into slot 1 on the rack, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：热端掉落。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的残余耗材，剪断残料后，将热端重新安装到挂架 1 位置，然后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: rack movement is blocked. Please check for any foreign objects, remove them, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: toolhead recentering retry failed. Please manually move the toolhead to the center of the build plate and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头回中重试失败，请手动将工具头移至热床中央后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while fetching the hotend from slot 1: no hotend found in this position. Please install a hotend in the corresponding slot before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：该位置未安装热端，请在对应位置安装热端后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while fetching the hotend from slot 1: a hotend is already mounted on the toolhead. Please remove the hotend from the toolhead before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头上已安装热端，请先卸下工具头上的热端后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 1: the toolhead failed to detect the hotend on the rack. Please check for any debris in the induction hotend mounting slot on the toolhead. If none is found, recalibrate the induction hotend rack.
rows.zh: 取用 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头未识别到挂架上的热端。请检查工具头感应热端固定槽内是否有异物，若无异常，请重新标定感应热端挂架。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 1: the rack failed to mount the hotend properly. Please check for excessive filament at the top of the hotend, debris in the contact area between the toolhead and the hotend, or if the locking lever is in the released position. After resolving the issue, click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未能将热端正确安装到位。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的残余料线，工具头与热端接触区是否有异物卡住，或锁紧拉柄是否处于拉开状态。处理完成后，请点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 1: the hotend has dropped. Please check for excessive filament or other debris at the top of the hotend, trim or remove it, then reinstall the hotend into slot 1 on the rack and click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：热端掉落。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的料线或其他异物，剪断料线或清除异物后，将热端重新安装到挂架 1 位置，然后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 1: rack movement is blocked. Please check for any foreign objects, remove them, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 1: toolhead recentering retry failed. Please manually move the toolhead to the center of the build plate and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头回中重试失败，请手动将工具头移至热床中央后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Open circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 2 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架槽位 2 位置霍尔传感器断路，请参照Wiki排查。

rows.en: Short circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 2 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.

rows.zh: 取用 2 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。

rows.zh: 放置 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：热端掉落。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的残余耗材，剪断残料后，将热端重新安装到挂架 3 位置，然后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 3: rack movement is blocked. Please check for any foreign objects, remove them, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 3: toolhead recentering retry failed. Please manually move the toolhead to the center of the build plate and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头回中重试失败，请手动将工具头移至热床中央后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while fetching the hotend from slot 3: no hotend found in this position. Please install a hotend in the corresponding slot before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：该位置未安装热端，请在对应位置安装热端后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while fetching the hotend from slot 3: a hotend is already mounted on the toolhead. Please remove the hotend from the toolhead before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头上已安装热端，请先卸下工具头上的热端后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 3: the toolhead failed to detect the hotend on the rack. Please check for any debris in the induction hotend mounting slot on the toolhead. If none is found, recalibrate the induction hotend rack.
rows.zh: 取用 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头未识别到挂架上的热端。请检查工具头感应热端固定槽内是否有异物，若无异常，请重新标定感应热端挂架。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 3: the rack failed to mount the hotend properly. Please check for excessive filament at the top of the hotend, debris in the contact area between the toolhead and the hotend, or if the locking lever is in the released position. After resolving the issue, click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未能将热端正确安装到位。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的残余料线，工具头与热端接触区是否有异物卡住，或锁紧拉柄是否处于拉开状态。处理完成后，请点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 3: the hotend has dropped. Please check for excessive filament or other debris at the top of the hotend, trim or remove it, then reinstall the hotend into slot 3 on the rack and click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：热端掉落。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的料线或其他异物，剪断料线或清除异物后，将热端重新安装到挂架 3 位置，然后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 3: rack movement is blocked. Please check for any foreign objects, remove them, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 3: toolhead recentering retry failed. Please manually move the toolhead to the center of the build plate and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 3 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头回中重试失败，请手动将工具头移至热床中央后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Open circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 4 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架槽位 4 位置霍尔传感器断路，请参照Wiki排查。

rows.en: Short circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 4 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架槽位 4 位置霍尔传感器短路，请参照Wiki排查。

rows.en: Error fetching/nesting the hotend in rack slot 4. Ensure the hotend holder has no hotend installed, the corresponding rack slot contains a hotend, and manually move the toolhead to the machine center before continuing.
rows.zh: 取放挂架槽位 4 热端时发生异常，请保证感应热端固定槽上无热端，对应挂架槽位上有热端，并手动将工具头移动到机器中央后再继续。

rows.en: Error fetching/nesting the hotend in rack slot 4. Ensure the hotend holder has a hotend installed, the corresponding rack slot is empty, and manually move the toolhead to the machine center before continuing.
rows.zh: 取放挂架槽位 4 热端时发生异常，请保证感应热端固定槽上有热端，对应挂架槽位上无热端，并手动将工具头移动到机器中央后再继续。

rows.en: Error detected before induction hotend replacement: no hotend installed in slot 4 on the rack.
rows.zh: 在更换感应热端前检测到错误，挂架位置 4 未安装热端。

rows.en: Error detected before induction hotend replacement: a hotend is already installed in slot 4 on the rack. Please remove it before continuing.
rows.zh: 在更换感应热端前检测到错误，挂架位置 4 已安装热端，请先取下该热端后再继续。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 4: a hotend is already installed. Please remove the existing one before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 4 槽位热端时检测到异常：该位置已安装热端，请先取下现有热端后再点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 4: no hotend detected on the toolhead. Please mount the hotend onto the toolhead before clicking “Continue.”

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 4. Please ensure no hotend is mounted on the toolhead and that a hotend is present in slot 4 on the rack before clicking “Continue.”

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 6: the rack failed to detach the hotend from the toolhead. Please make sure the locking lever is in the released position.
rows.zh: 放置 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未能从工具头上成功取下热端，请确保锁紧拉柄已处于拉开状态。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 6: the hotend has dropped. Please check for excessive filament remaining at the top of the hotend, trim the residue, reinstall the hotend into slot 6 on the rack, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：热端掉落。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的残余耗材，剪断残料后，将热端重新安装到挂架 6 位置，然后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 6: rack movement is blocked. Please check for any foreign objects, remove them, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 6: toolhead recentering retry failed. Please manually move the toolhead to the center of the build plate and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 放置 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头回中重试失败，请手动将工具头移至热床中央后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while fetching the hotend from slot 6: no hotend found in this position. Please install a hotend in the corresponding slot before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：该位置未安装热端，请在对应位置安装热端后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Abnormal condition detected while fetching the hotend from slot 6: a hotend is already mounted on the toolhead. Please remove the hotend from the toolhead before clicking “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头上已安装热端，请先卸下工具头上的热端后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 6: the toolhead failed to detect the hotend on the rack. Please check for any debris in the induction hotend mounting slot on the toolhead. If none is found, recalibrate the induction hotend rack.
rows.zh: 取用 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头未识别到挂架上的热端。请检查工具头感应热端固定槽内是否有异物，若无异常，请重新标定感应热端挂架。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 6: the rack failed to mount the hotend properly. Please check for excessive filament at the top of the hotend, debris in the contact area between the toolhead and the hotend, or if the locking lever is in the released position. After resolving the issue, click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未能将热端正确安装到位。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的残余料线，工具头与热端接触区是否有异物卡住，或锁紧拉柄是否处于拉开状态。处理完成后，请点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 6: the hotend has dropped. Please check for excessive filament or other debris at the top of the hotend, trim or remove it, then reinstall the hotend into slot 6 on the rack and click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：热端掉落。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的料线或其他异物，剪断料线或清除异物后，将热端重新安装到挂架 6 位置，然后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 6: rack movement is blocked. Please check for any foreign objects, remove them, and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Error detected while fetching the hotend from slot 6: toolhead recentering retry failed. Please manually move the toolhead to the center of the build plate and then click “Continue.”
rows.zh: 取用 6 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头回中重试失败，请手动将工具头移至热床中央后点击“继续”。

rows.en: Toolhead XY axis or hotend rack has not finished homing. Hotend replacement cannot proceed.
rows.zh: 工具头 XY 轴或热端挂架未完成回中，无法更换热端。

rows.en: Hotend rack coarse homing failed. Please check for any obstructions.
rows.zh: 热端挂架粗回中失败，请检查是否有异物阻挡。

rows.en: Induction Hotend Rack coarse homing failed due to excessive travel. Please check the timing belt condition.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架粗回中行程过长失败，请检查同步带状态。

rows.en: Induction hotend rack calibration failed: camera position calibration error. Please clean the toolhead camera, remove any debris from the thermal paper surface at the rear of the build plate, and remove residue from the nozzle.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架标定失败：摄像头位置标定异常。请擦拭工具头摄像头，清理热床后侧热敏纸表面料屑，以及喷嘴上残料。

rows.en: Induction hotend rack calibration failed: the white marker on the rack’s induction hotend docking module was not detected. Please refer to the Wiki to check if the marker is damaged or covered by dirt, and clean the toolhead camera.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架标定失败：未识别到挂架感应热端泊位组件上的白色标志，请参考 Wiki 检查该标志是否损坏或被污物遮挡，并擦拭工具头摄像头。

rows.en: Induction hotend rack calibration failed: abnormal calibration result. Please refer to the Wiki to check if the rack structure is deformed.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架标定失败：标定结果异常，请参考 Wiki 检查挂架结构是否存在变形。

rows.en: Hotend rack height calibration is abnormal. Please check for any foreign objects that may be causing the rack to jam.
rows.zh: 热端挂架高度标定异常，请检查是否有异物导致挂架运动卡滞。

rows.en: The hotend rack motion timed out. Please check for any foreign objects or obstructions that may be causing the rack to jam.
rows.zh: 热端挂架运动卡住，请检查是否有异物导致挂架运动受阻。

rows.en: The hotend rack tool lock rod position is abnormal. Please check for any foreign objects or obstructions that may be causing the lock rod to jam.
rows.zh: 热端挂架拉柄解锁组件位置异常，请检查是否有异物导致其卡滞或本身安装不到位。

rows.en: Induction hotend locking lever or rack lever release mechanism error. Please refer to the Wiki for inspection.
rows.zh: 感应热端锁紧拉柄或挂架拉柄解锁组件异常，请参考 Wiki 进行检查。

rows.en: The Induction Hotend Rack has not been set up. Please follow the instructions to complete the setup before using its functions.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架暂未初始化，请按指示初始化后再使用挂架相关功能。

rows.en: Induction hotend not detected before locking. Please check its installation on the toolhead.
rows.zh: 锁紧前未识别到感应热端，请检查其是否在工具头上正确安装。

rows.en: The hotend rack is fully occupied. Please remove at least one hotend before proceeding.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架上热端已装满。请移除任意一个热端后继续操作。

rows.en: Power outage occurred during hotend replacement. Please follow the Wiki guide to restore the setup, otherwise printing may fail.
rows.zh: 换热端时断电。请按 Wiki 指南恢复现场，否则可能导致打印失败。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend back to slot 1 on the rack, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将热端装回挂架位置 1，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend from slot 1 on the rack back onto the toolhead, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将挂架位置 1 的热端装回工具头，并将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting hotend. Check if the hotend is in slot 1 on the rack. If not, nest it back to that slot and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请检查热端是否位于挂架位置 1。如未在，请将热端装回该位置，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Check if it’s mounted on the toolhead. If not, fetch it from slot 1 on the rack, nest it onto the toolhead, and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请先检查热端是否安装在工具头上。如未安装，请从挂架位置 1 取下热端并装回工具头，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend back to slot 2 on the rack, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将热端装回挂架位置 2，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend from slot 2 on the rack back onto the toolhead, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将挂架位置 2 的热端装回工具头，并将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting hotend. Check if the hotend is in slot 2 on the rack. If not, nest it back to that slot and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请检查热端是否位于挂架位置 2。如未在，请将热端装回该位置，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Check if it’s mounted on the toolhead. If not, fetch it from slot 2 on the rack, nest it onto the toolhead, and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请先检查热端是否安装在工具头上。如未安装，请从挂架位置 2 取下热端并装回工具头，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend back to slot 3 on the rack, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将热端装回挂架位置 3，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend from slot 3 on the rack back onto the toolhead, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将挂架位置 3 的热端装回工具头，并将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting hotend. Check if the hotend is in slot 3 on the rack. If not, nest it back to that slot and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请检查热端是否位于挂架位置 3。如未在，请将热端装回该位置，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Check if it’s mounted on the toolhead. If not, fetch it from slot 3 on the rack, nest it onto the toolhead, and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请先检查热端是否安装在工具头上。如未安装，请从挂架位置 3 取下热端并装回工具头，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend back to slot 4 on the rack, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将热端装回挂架位置 4，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend from slot 4 on the rack back onto the toolhead, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将挂架位置 4 的热端装回工具头，并将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting hotend. Check if the hotend is in slot 4 on the rack. If not, nest it back to that slot and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请检查热端是否位于挂架位置 4。如未在，请将热端装回该位置，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Check if it’s mounted on the toolhead. If not, fetch it from slot 4 on the rack, nest it onto the toolhead, and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请先检查热端是否安装在工具头上。如未安装，请从挂架位置 4 取下热端并装回工具头，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend back to slot 5 on the rack, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将热端装回挂架位置 5，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend from slot 5 on the rack back onto the toolhead, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将挂架位置 5 的热端装回工具头，并将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting hotend. Check if the hotend is in slot 5 on the rack. If not, nest it back to that slot and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请检查热端是否位于挂架位置 5。如未在，请将热端装回该位置，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Check if it’s mounted on the toolhead. If not, fetch it from slot 5 on the rack, nest it onto the toolhead, and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请先检查热端是否安装在工具头上。如未安装，请从挂架位置 5 取下热端并装回工具头，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend back to slot 6 on the rack, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将热端装回挂架位置 6，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Please nest the hotend from slot 6 on the rack back onto the toolhead, then move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请将挂架位置 6 的热端装回工具头，并将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting hotend. Check if the hotend is in slot 6 on the rack. If not, nest it back to that slot and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请检查热端是否位于挂架位置 6。如未在，请将热端装回该位置，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: Power loss occurred while fetching/nesting the hotend. Check if it’s mounted on the toolhead. If not, fetch it from slot 6 on the rack, nest it onto the toolhead, and move the toolhead to the center of the build plate.
rows.zh: 在取放热端过程中发生断电，请先检查热端是否安装在工具头上。如未安装，请从挂架位置 6 取下热端并装回工具头，然后将工具头移至热床中央。

rows.en: The toolhead induction hotend presence detection sensor is open-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 工具头感应热端在位检测传感器断路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The toolhead induction hotend presence detection sensor is short-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 工具头感应热端在位检测传感器短路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The toolhead locking lever position sensor is open-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 工具头上锁紧拉柄位置传感器断路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The toolhead locking lever position sensor is short-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 工具头上锁紧拉柄位置传感器短路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The hotend rack lever release mechanism sensor is open-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 热端挂架拉柄解锁组件传感器断路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The hotend rack lever release mechanism sensor is short-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 热端挂架拉柄解锁组件传感器短路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The hotend rack position detection sensor is open-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 热端挂架位置检测传感器断路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The hotend rack position detection sensor is short-circuit. Please reconnect the sensor cable or replace the sensor.
rows.zh: 热端挂架位置检测传感器短路，请重新插拔传感器连接线或更换传感器。

rows.en: The Induction Hotend Rack is blocked by an obstacle during homing. Please clear any obstructions from its movement path.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架回中过程中被异物阻挡，请清理挂架运动路径上异物。

rows.en: Induction Hotend Rack homing distance is too long. The timing belt may be loose. Please check and tighten.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架回中行程过长，可能是同步带过松，请检查并张紧同步带。

rows.en: Filter life is low. Please replace the filter promptly.
rows.zh: 滤芯剩余寿命不足，请及时更换。

rows.en: High PM2.5 concentration detected. Please check if the filter is installed or has failed.
rows.zh: PM2.5浓度过高，请检查滤芯是否安装或已失效。

rows.en: Z axis homing failed; the task has been stopped.
rows.zh: Z轴回零失败，任务已停止。

rows.en: The printer timed out waiting for the nozzle to cool down before homing.
rows.zh: 工具头降温超时。

rows.en: Auto Bed Leveling failed; the task has been stopped.
rows.zh: 热床调平失败，任务已停止。

rows.en: The hotend cooling fan speed is abnormal.
rows.zh: 热端散热风扇转速异常。

rows.en: The nozzle is clogged.
rows.zh: 喷嘴堵头。

rows.en: The AMS failed to change filament.
rows.zh: AMS换料失败。

rows.en: Homing XY axis failed.
rows.zh: XY回零失败。

rows.en: Mechanical resonance frequency identification failed.
rows.zh: 振动扫频识别失败。

rows.en: Internal communication exception
rows.zh: 内部通讯异常。

rows.en: The task was canceled.
rows.zh: 任务已取消。

rows.en: Resume failed after power loss.
rows.zh: 断电续打失败。

rows.en: The motor self-check failed.
rows.zh: 电机参数自检失败。

rows.en: The power supply voltage does not match the printer.
rows.zh: 电源电压与打印机不匹配。

rows.en: Nozzle offset calibration failed.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准失败

rows.en: Flow Dynamics Calibration failed; please reinitiate printing or calibration.
rows.zh: 动态流量校准失败。请重新发起打印或校准。

rows.en: Printing cannot be initiated while AMS is drying.
rows.zh: AMS烘干中，不能发起打印。

rows.en: Homing Z axis failed: temperature control abnormality.
rows.zh: Z回零失败：温控异常。

rows.en: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. Please go to "Assistant" for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 喷嘴裹头位置检测失败，请前往“助手”排查问题。

rows.en: Nozzle cleaning failed. Please click the Assistant for troubleshooting.
rows.zh: 喷嘴清理失败，请查看助手排除故障。

rows.en: Induction hotend rack homing failed. The task has been stopped. Please clear any debris around the rack.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架回中失败，任务已停止。请清理挂架周围异物。

rows.en: The hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
rows.zh: 热端未安装，无法进行回中。请安装热端后再继续操作。

variants.093: The hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
variants.094: The right hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
variants.20P: The right hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
variants.22E: The hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
variants.239: The right hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
variants.26A: The hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
variants.31B: The right hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.

rows.en: The nozzle presence detection failed. Please check the Assistant for details.
rows.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败。请前往助手查看详情。

rows.en: Nozzle offset calibration sensor signal abnormality detected. Please check the sensor and retry.
rows.zh: 检测到喷嘴偏移校准传感器信号异常。建议排查传感器故障后重试。

rows.en: Z-axis homing failed. Remove the heated bed slider fixing screws and ensure no obstructions are blocking the heated bed's vertical movement. After resolving the issue, recalibrate on the device.
rows.zh: Z轴回零失败，请取出热床滑块固定螺丝并确认热床升降无异物阻挡，解决问题后在设备上重新校准。

rows.en: The nozzle has not been installed. Please install the nozzle and recalibrate.
rows.zh: 检测到喷嘴未安装。请安装喷嘴后重新校准。

rows.en: XY homing failed. Please remove any foreign objects obstructing the toolhead movement and recalibrate.
rows.zh: XY回零失败，请移除阻挡工具头移动的异物后再重新校准。

rows.en: Z-axis homing failed due to a temperature control abnormality. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
rows.zh: Z轴回零失败：温控异常。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

rows.en: Toolhead homing failed due to the induction hotend rack being stuck. Please remove foreign objects from the rack and then recalibrate.
rows.zh: 感应热端挂架位置卡住，工具头无法回零。请检查挂架上是否有异物，清除后再重新校准。

rows.en: Nozzle cleaning failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
rows.zh: 喷嘴清理失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

rows.en: Nozzle offset calibration failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

rows.en: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
rows.zh: 喷嘴裹头位置检测失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

rows.en: Heatbed leveling failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
rows.zh: 热床调平失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

rows.en: The nozzle presence detection failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
rows.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

rows.en: The Laser Safety Window is not properly installed. The task has been stopped.
rows.zh: 未正确安装激光防护视窗，任务已停止。

rows.en: The Flame Sensor is abnormal. The sensor may be short-circuited. Please troubleshoot the issue before starting a print job.
rows.zh: 火焰传感器异常，传感器可能短路，请排查故障后再发起任务。

rows.en: Task aborted because the front door or top cover is open.
rows.zh: 任务终止，检测到机箱前门或上盖打开。

rows.en: The current temperature of the hotend, heatbed, or chamber is too high. Please wait for it to cool down to room temperature before restarting the task.
rows.zh: 当前热端、热床或腔体温度过高，请等待温度降至室温后重新发起任务。

rows.en: Liveview Camera calibration timeout; please restart the printer.
rows.zh: 实况相机校准响应超时，请重启打印机。

rows.en: Blade Z-axis homing failed
rows.zh: 切割刀Z轴回零失败

rows.en: Z-axis step loss detected. The task has stopped. Please check if there are any obstructions beneath the heatbed.
rows.zh: 检测到Z轴丢步，任务已停止，请检查热床下方是否有异物。

variants.093: Z-axis step loss detected. The task has stopped. Please check if there are any obstructions beneath the heatbed.
variants.094: Z-axis step loss detected. The task has stopped. Please check if there are any obstructions beneath the heatbed.
variants.239: Z-axis step loss detected. The task has stopped. Please check if there are any obstructions beneath the heatbed.
variants.26A: Z-axis step loss detected. The task has stopped. Please check if there are any obstructions beneath the toolhead.
variants.31B: Z-axis step loss detected. The task has stopped. Please check if there are any obstructions beneath the heatbed.

rows.en: The workpiece on the rotary attachment collided with the toolhead. The task has been stopped.
rows.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴上的加工物体与工具头碰撞，任务已停止。

rows.en: Calibration of motion precision failed.
rows.zh: 运动精度增强发生异常，请查看助手。

rows.en: Calibration result is over the threshold.
rows.zh: 校准完成，运动精度有提升。由于机器结构的老化等原因，可能不是最佳效果。

rows.en: Step loss occurred during the motion accuracy enhancement process. Please try again.
rows.zh: 运动精度增强过程发生丢步，请重试。

rows.en: Toolhead communication lost and abnormal current detected. The toolhead power has been cut off. Please restart the device. If the issue persists, contact customer support.
rows.zh: 工具头通信丢失且电流异常，已自动切断工具头电源。请重启设备；若问题反复出现，请联系售后支持。

rows.en: Task command timed out due to a communication issue. Please retry.
rows.zh: 指令下发超时，可能是通讯异常，请尝试重新发起任务。

rows.en: Task was paused for unknown reason. You can select "Resume" to resume the task.
rows.zh: 未知原因暂停。你可以点击“继续”来恢复任务。

rows.en: Job was paused by the user. You can select "Resume" to continue.
rows.zh: 用户暂停。你可以点击“继续”来恢复任务。

rows.en: First layer defects were detected by the Micro Lidar. Please check the quality of the printed model before continuing your print.
rows.zh: 激光雷达检测到首层缺陷,请检查打印件状况后决定是否继续。

rows.en: Spaghetti defects were detected by the AI Print Monitoring. Please check the quality of the printed model before continuing your print. Cleaning the build plate with detergent or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
rows.zh: AI检测到炒面缺陷。请检查打印件状况后做相应处理。使用清洗剂清洁打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

rows.en: Filament ran out. Please load new filament.
rows.zh: 打印耗材用尽，请加载新料。

rows.en: Toolhead front cover fell off. Please remount the front cover and check to make sure your print is going okay.
rows.zh: 工具头前盖掉落。请把前盖重新装上，并检查打印件是否完好。

rows.en: The build plate marker was not detected. Please confirm the build plate is correctly positioned on the heatbed with all four corners aligned, and the marker is visible.
rows.zh: 未检测到打印板定位标识。请检查打印板是否放置且四角对齐，并保证定位标识清晰无磨损。

rows.en: There was an unfinished print job when the printer lost power. If the model is still adhered to the build plate, you can try resuming the print job.
rows.zh: 检测到断电时有未完成的打印任务。如果模型仍然粘接在底板上，可尝试继续打印。

rows.en: Nozzle temperature malfunction. Check the Assistant page and resolve the issue before retrying heating.
rows.zh: 喷嘴温控故障：请前往助手页面查看详情，排除异常后再重新加热。

rows.en: Heatbed temperature malfunction
rows.zh: 热床温控故障。

rows.en: A Filament pile-up was detected by AI Print Monitoring. Please clean filament from the waste chute.
rows.zh: AI打印监控检测到垃圾桶处废料堆积，请及时清理。

rows.en: The cutter is stuck. Please make sure the cutter handle is out and check the filament sensor cable connection.
rows.zh: 切刀已卡住，请确保切刀刀柄弹回及耗材霍尔开关接线正常。

rows.en: Multiple motion step loss detected. Please first check if the toolhead is blocked by foreign objects or making abnormal noise. You may continue printing and observe the print quality. If obvious layer shifting occurs on the print, refer to the Wiki for maintenance.
rows.zh: 检测到多次运动丢步，请先检查工具头是否存在异物阻挡或运行异响。可继续打印并观察打印件状态，若出现明显错层，请参考 Wiki 进行维护。

rows.en: Detected that the extruder is not extruding normally. If the defects are acceptable, select "Resume" to resume the print job.
rows.zh: 检测到没有正常挤出。如果缺陷可接受，可点击"继续打印"按钮来恢复打印任务。

rows.en: The print file is not available. Please check to see if the storage media has been removed.
rows.zh: 检测到打印文件不可用。请确认存储介质是否被移除。

rows.en: The door seems to be open, so printing was paused.
rows.zh: 检测到门已打开，暂停打印。

rows.en: The hotend cooling fan speed is abnormal.
rows.zh: 热端散热风扇转速异常。

rows.en: Detected build plate is not the same as the Gcode file. Please adjust slicer settings or use the correct plate.
rows.zh: 检测到的打印板类型与切片G代码中不一致。请修改切片参数或者使用匹配的打印板。

rows.en: Task paused due to the pause command added to the file.
rows.zh: 任务暂停，因为文件中添加了暂停命令。

rows.en: The nozzle is covered with filament, or the build plate is installed incorrectly. Please cancel this print and clean the nozzle or adjust the build plate according to the actual status. You can also select "Resume" to resume the print job.
rows.zh: 检测到喷嘴裹料或打印板放歪，请根据实际状态，取消本次打印并清理喷嘴或调整热床，或点击“继续”按钮恢复打印任务。

rows.en: The filament on external spool has run out; please load new filament. If the filament is loaded, please select "Resume".
rows.zh: 外挂料盘上的耗材用尽，请进料新的耗材。如果已经执行进料流程，请点击"继续"。

rows.en: The nozzle is clogged with filament. Please cancel this print and clean the nozzle or select "Resume" to resume the print job.
rows.zh: 检测到挤出机无法挤出料。请根据实际状态，取消本次打印并清理挤出机，或点击“继续打印”按钮恢复打印任务。

rows.en: Foreign objects detected on heatbed. Please check and clean the heatbed. Then, select "Resume" to resume the print job.
rows.zh: 检测到热床上有异物，请检查并清理后，再点击“继续打印”按钮继续打印。

rows.en: Chamber temperature malfunction.
rows.zh: 腔体温控故障。

rows.en: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
rows.zh: 未检测到打印板。请检查打印板表面是否存在鼓包或异物，并确保喷嘴已清理干净。

variants.00M: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.01P: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.03W: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.093: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.094: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.20P: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.22E: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.239: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
variants.26A: No build plate detected. Please place the build plate correctly and clean the build plate surface, any debris in the Y-axis rail groove, and filament residue on the nozzle. If debris is found in the rail groove, stop the current task and restart the print; once resolved, tap “Continue”.
variants.31B: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.

rows.en: Filament extrusion error; please check the assistant for troubleshooting. After resolving the issue, decide whether to cancel or resume the print job based on the actual print status.
rows.zh: 耗材挤出异常，请查看助手。排除故障后，根据实际打印件状态，选择取消或者继续打印。

rows.en: Nozzle temperature problem detected. Refer to Assistant to re-connect the hotend connector. POWER OFF the printer before this operation to avoid short circuits.
rows.zh: 喷嘴温控故障，请查看助手重新插接喷嘴接线。全过程请断电操作，否则可能有短路风险。

rows.en: Abnormal extrusion resistance was detected, and the extruder may be clogged. Please refer to the Assistant to resolve the issue. After troubleshooting, click "Resume" to continue the print job.
rows.zh: 检测到挤出机挤出阻力异常，可能发生堵头。请查看助手并排除异常，完成后点击“继续”以恢复打印任务。

rows.en: An abnormality was detected in the extruder motor position sensor. Power off the printer first, then check whether the motor cable is loose.
rows.zh: 检测到挤出电机位置传感器异常。请先切断电源，再检查电机连接线是否松动。

rows.en: The extrusion motor is overloaded, please check the Assistant for details.
rows.zh: 挤出电机过载，请前往助手查看详情。

rows.en: The nozzle may not be installed or not properly installed. Please ensure the nozzle is correctly installed before proceeding.
rows.zh: 喷嘴可能未安装或安装未到位，请正确安装后继续。

rows.en: During subsequent printing, the heatbed may encounter resistance while lowering. Please clear any foreign objects from beneath the heatbed and observe whether its movement is obstructed.
rows.zh: 在后续打印过程中，热床下降可能受阻，请清理热床底部异物，并观察热床移动是否卡顿。

rows.en: XY motor homing failed during Rack homing. Please check for obstructions and retry.
rows.zh: 挂架回中过程中，XY电机回中失败，请检查是否有异物后重试。

rows.en: Rack homing blocked. Please check for obstructions and retry.
rows.zh: 挂架回中受阻失败，请检查是否有异物阻挡后重试。

rows.en: Rack homing distance too long. Please inspect the timing belt and motor gear for looseness or damage.
rows.zh: 挂架回中距离过长，请检查同步带和挂架电机齿轮是否松动或损坏。

rows.en: Laser/Calibration mode: Please remove all hotends from the holder before retrying.
rows.zh: 激光/标定模式：请先将热端从支架上全部取下后重试。

rows.en: Hotend dropped from the Rack during printing. Please return it to the original position before continuing.
rows.zh: 打印过程中热端从挂架上掉落，请将其放回原位后继续打印。

rows.en: Nozzle offset calibration sensor error. If using a single hotend or the calibration function is disabled, you may ignore this and continue printing; otherwise, it is recommended to check the sensor before proceeding.
rows.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器异常，若使用单热端打印或已关闭校准功能，可忽略继续打印；否则建议先排查故障。

rows.en: MC–hotend rack communication error. Please check if the rack mainboard cable is loose.
rows.zh: MC与热端挂架通信异常，请检查挂架主板连接线是否松脱。

rows.en: Hotend rack motor position sensor error. If the issue persists after retrying, restart the printer.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机位置传感器异常，如重试无效，请重启打印机。

rows.en: Hotend rack motor error. Please check and remove any obstructions affecting rack movement before continuing.
rows.zh: 热端挂架电机异常，请检查并清理可能影响挂架运动的异物后再继续。

rows.en: A nozzle-clumping sensor error has been detected. Please cancel the print and service the sensor, or disable clumping detection function and continue printing.
rows.zh: 检测到裹头检测传感器异常，请取消打印并维修传感器，或关闭裹头检测功能后继续打印。

rows.en: Platform detection timeout: please restart the printer.
rows.zh: 垫板检测超时，请重启打印机。

rows.en: Task paused because the door or top cover is open.
rows.zh: 任务暂停，检测到机箱前门或上盖打开。

variants.093: Task paused because the door or top cover is open.
variants.094: Task paused because the door or top cover is open.
variants.20P: The front door seems to be open; the task has been paused.
variants.22E: The front door seems to be open; the task has been paused.
variants.239: Task paused because the door or top cover is open.
variants.31B: Task paused because the door or top cover is open.

rows.en: The laser module is abnormal.
rows.zh: 激光模组异常。

rows.en: Fire detected inside the chamber.
rows.zh: 检测到机箱内起火。

rows.en: Material detection timeout: please restart the printer.
rows.zh: 制作材料检测超时，请重启打印机。

rows.en: Foreign object detect timeout: please restart the printer.
rows.zh: 异物检测超时，请重启打印机。

rows.en: Quick-release lever detection time out: please restart the printer.
rows.zh: 快拆锁扣检测超时，请重启打印机。

rows.en: Laser Module unlock has timed out, and the task cannot proceed. Please restart the device and try again.
rows.zh: 激光模组解锁超时，任务无法继续，请重启机器后重试。

rows.en: The current plate is invalid.
rows.zh: 当前垫板非法

rows.en: Emergency stop button improperly installed. Please reinstall according to the Wiki before proceeding.
rows.zh: 急停按钮安装状态异常，请按照Wiki正确安装后继续任务。

rows.en: Task paused. The Laser Safety Window is open.
rows.zh: 任务暂停，检测到激光防护视窗打开。

rows.en: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
rows.zh: 打印任务进行中，请将激光/刀切模组从工具头取下。

variants.093: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
variants.094: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
variants.20P: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
variants.22E: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
variants.239: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
variants.26A: Printing in progress. Please remove the Cutting Module from the toolhead.
variants.31B: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.

rows.en: The loading/unloading process is currently ongoing. Please stop the process or remove the laser/cutting module.
rows.zh: 设备正在进退料。请停止当前流程，或取下激光/刀切模组。

rows.en: This device does not support the 40W Laser Module. Please remove it or replace it with a 10W Laser Module.
rows.zh: 该设备不支持40W激光模组，请移除或更换10W激光模组。

rows.en: The cutting module has dropped or the cutting module cable is disconnected; please check the module.
rows.zh: 刀切模组掉落或者连接线脱落，请检查。

rows.en: Laser module detected. Please install the right nozzle correctly to ensure proper Laser Module Mounting Calibration.
rows.zh: 已检测到激光模组，请正确安装右喷嘴，以确保后续激光模组挂载校准正常。

rows.en: Please place the paper required for Print Then Cut.
rows.zh: 请放置打印后刀切工序所需的纸张

rows.en: The module mounted on the toolhead does not match the task. Please install the correct module.
rows.zh: 当前工具头挂载的模组与任务不匹配，请安装正确的模组。

rows.en: Laser module detected. Please remove the hotend from the hotend rack to prevent laser processing debris from affecting printing performance.
rows.zh: 检测到激光模组，请取下热端挂架上的热端，以防激光加工碎屑影响热端打印功能。

rows.en: The rotary attachment is disconnected. Please ensure it is properly installed and the cable is securely plugged in.
rows.zh: 检测到旋转轴附件未连接，请确认附件已正确安装并插好连接线。

rows.en: Rotary attachment detected. Please remove it before proceeding.
rows.zh: 请先取下旋转轴附件，再进行操作。

rows.en: Motor step loss detected. Please check the processing quality. If the quality is acceptable, continue; otherwise, stop the task.
rows.zh: 检测到电机丢步，请检查加工质量。若质量可接受，可继续执行；若不可接受，请停止任务。

rows.en: Please check whether the cutting platform is properly positioned and not shifted, then continue.
rows.zh: 检测到刀切垫板未正确放置，请调整后继续。

rows.en: The mode of Airflow System failed to activate; check the air door condition.
rows.zh: 风道系统切换或维持失败，请检查风门状态。

rows.en: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.
rows.zh: 腔温过高，可能因为环境温度过高。

variants.093: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.
variants.094: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.
variants.20P: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.
variants.22E: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.
variants.239: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.
variants.26A: The ambient temperature is too high; please lower it.
variants.31B: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.

rows.en: The chamber temperature is too high. Please open the top cover and front door to cool down.
rows.zh: 腔温过高，请打开上盖和前门降温。

rows.en: The chamber temperature is too high. Please open the top cover and front door to cool down. (Open door detection for this print job will be set to "Notification" level)
rows.zh: 腔温过高，请打开上盖和前门降温。（打开上盖或前门后，本次打印的开门检测功能将设置为“通知”级别）

rows.en: The temperature of the MC module is too high. Please check the Wiki for possible explanations.
rows.zh: MC模块温度过高，请前往Wiki排查具体原因。

rows.en: Abnormal nozzle temperature control detected; the heating module may be damaged. Please disconnect the power immediately and stop using the device.
rows.zh: 喷嘴温控异常，可能为加热模块损坏。请立即断开设备电源。

rows.en: Abnormal temperature rise detected on the heatbed. The heating module may be damaged. Please power off the device immediately and stop using it.
rows.zh: 热床异常升温，可能为加热模块损坏，请立即断开设备电源并停止使用。

rows.en: The chamber heater temperature is rising abnormally and the heating module may be damaged. Please power off the device immediately and stop using the device.
rows.zh: 检测到腔温加热器异常升温，可能为加热模块损坏。请立即断开设备电源并停止使用。

rows.en: The Toolhead Enhanced Cooling Fan module is malfunctioning.
rows.zh: 工具头散热增强风扇模组异常。

rows.en: Fire Extinguisher not detected, the automatic extinguishing function will be unavailable.
rows.zh: 灭火器未连接，自动灭火功能将无法使用。

rows.en: Fire Extinguisher not detected, the automatic extinguishing function will be unavailable.
rows.zh: 灭火器未连接，自动灭火功能将无法使用。

rows.en: Fire Extinguisher is malfunctioning. Please unplug and reconnect the power cable.
rows.zh: 灭火器功能异常，请重新插拔电源线。

rows.en: Fire extinguisher motor reset failed. Please check Assistant for more details.
rows.zh: 灭火器电机复位失败，请前往助手查看详情。

rows.en: Fire extinguisher cylinder not installed. Please confirm on the extinguisher page.
rows.zh: 灭火器气瓶未安装，请前往自动灭火界面确认。

rows.en: The Fire Extinguisher Gas Cylinder is empty. Please replace the gas cylinder and then confirm the replacement on the Auto Fire Extinguishing System page.
rows.zh: 灭火器气瓶已耗尽，请及时更换气瓶。若已更换气瓶，请在自动灭火界面进行确认。

rows.en: The right hotend heatbreak temperature is too high, which may cause clogging. Please open the printer’s top cover and front door to reduce the chamber temperature, or lower the ambient temperature.
rows.zh: 右热端散热片温度过高，可能导致热端堵头。请打开打印机上盖和前门以降低腔温，或降低环境温度。

rows.en: Please heat the nozzle to above 170°C.
rows.zh: 请将喷嘴加热至170℃以上。

rows.en: A minor fire was detected inside the chamber, and the Auto Fire Extinguishing process has been aborted.
rows.zh: 机箱内火势较小，已取消自动灭火。

rows.en: The fire extinguisher has been detected and is ready for use after the laser module is connected.
rows.zh: 检测到灭火器接入，待激光组件接入后即可使用。

rows.en: Failed to connect to Bambu Cloud. Please check your network connection.
rows.zh: 无法连接服务器，请检查网络连接。

rows.en: Unsupported file path or name. Please resend the task.
rows.zh: 不支持的文件路径或者名称，请重新发起任务。

rows.en: Task stopped because the device was unable to parse the file. Please resend your job.
rows.zh: 解析文件遇到问题，任务已停止。请重新发送任务。

rows.en: Device is busy and cannot start new task. Please wait for current task to complete before sending new task.
rows.zh: 设备正忙，无法启动新的任务，请在当前任务结束后再发送新任务。

rows.en: Tasks are not allowed to be sent while updating firmware.
rows.zh: 不允许在固件更新过程中发送任务。

rows.en: There is not enough free storage space for the job. Restoring to factory settings can free up available space.
rows.zh: 内部存储空间不足，可恢复出厂设置以释放所有可用空间。

rows.en: The device requires a repair upgrade. Task cannot be started.
rows.zh: 设备需要修复升级，无法进行任务。

rows.en: Starting task failed; please power cycle the device and resend the task.
rows.zh: 启动任务失败，请重启机器并重新发送任务。

rows.en: Jobs are not allowed to be sent while updating logs.
rows.zh: 不允许在日志上传过程中发送任务。

rows.en: The file name is not supported. Please rename and restart the task.
rows.zh: 文件名不支持，请修改文件名并重新发送任务。

rows.en: There was a problem downloading a file. Please check your network connection and resend the task.
rows.zh: 文件下载错误，请检查网络并重新发送任务。

rows.en: Please insert a MicroSD card and restart the print job.
rows.zh: 请插入MicroSD卡，重新发送打印。

rows.en: Please run a self-test and restart the task.
rows.zh: 请运行自检后重新启动任务。

rows.en: Job was cancelled.
rows.zh: 任务已取消。

rows.en: AMS is initializing and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS 正在初始化，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS is drying and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS 正在烘干，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

rows.en: The printer is loading or unloading filament and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
rows.zh: 打印机正在进退料，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

rows.en: The device is working and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
rows.zh: 设备正在工作，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS is in operation and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again when it is idle.
rows.zh: AMS 工作中，暂无法升级，请待空闲后重试。

rows.en: Slicing for the job failed. Please check your settings and restart the job.
rows.zh: 云端切片发生错误，请检查切片参数并重新发起作业。

rows.en: There is not enough free storage space for the print job. Please format or clear files from the MicroSD card to free up space.
rows.zh: 设备存储空间不足，无法打印。请格式化或清理SD卡以释放可用空间。

rows.en: The MicroSD Card is write-protected. Please replace the MicroSD Card.
rows.zh: MicroSD卡进入写保护，请更换MicroSD卡。

rows.en: Binding failed. Please retry or restart the device and retry.
rows.zh: 绑定操作失败，可重试或重启设备后重试。

rows.en: Binding configuration information parsing failed; please try again.
rows.zh: 绑定配置信息解析失败，请重试。

rows.en: The device has already been bound. Please unbind it and try again.
rows.zh: 设备已经绑定。请解除绑定，然后重试。

rows.en: Cloud access failed. Possible reasons include network instability caused by interference, inability to access the internet, or router firewall configuration restrictions. You can try moving the device closer to the router or checking the router configuration before trying again.
rows.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，或不具备internet访问能力，或路由器防火墙限制。可移动设备到路由器附近或检测路由器配置后重试。

rows.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Cloud access is rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Cloud access failed, which may be caused by network instability due to interference. You can try moving the device closer to the router before you try again.
rows.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，可移动设备到路由器附近后重试。

rows.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Authorization timed out. Please make sure that your phone or PC has access to the internet, and ensure that the Bambu Studio/Bambu Handy APP is running in the foreground during the binding operation.
rows.zh: 云端绑定授权超时，请检查手机或PC具备访问internet能力，并保证绑定操作时Bmabu Studio/Handy APP在前台执行。

rows.en: Cloud access rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Cloud access failed, which may be caused by network instability due to interference. You can try moving the device closer to the router before you try again.
rows.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，可移动设备到路由器附近后重试。

rows.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Cloud access rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，或不具备互联网访问能力，或路由器防火墙限制。可移动设备到路由器附近或检测路由器配置后重试。

rows.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Cloud access rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Cloud access failed; this may be caused by network instability due to interference. You can try moving the device closer to the router before you try again.
rows.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，可移动设备到路由器附近后重试。

rows.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Cloud access is rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
rows.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

rows.en: Failed to connect to the router, which may be caused by wireless interference or being too far away from the router. Please try again or move the device closer to the router and try again.
rows.zh: 连接路由器失败，可能是无线环境干扰或距离路由器较远，可重试或移动设备到路由器附近重试。

rows.en: Router connection failed due to incorrect password. Please check the password and try again.
rows.zh: 连接路由器密码错误，请检查密码后重试。

rows.en: Failed to obtain IP address, which may be caused by wireless interference resulting in data transmission failure or the DHCP address pool of the router being full. Please move the device closer to the router and try again. If the issue persists, please check router settings to see whether the IP addresses have been exhausted.
rows.zh: 未成功获取IP地址，可能是无线环境干扰导致数据收发未成功或路由器DHCP地址池满，可移动设备到路由器附近后重试。若多次失败需要检查路由器DHCP地址池是否已耗尽。

rows.en: System exception
rows.zh: 系统发生异常。

rows.en: The file system of the current MicroSD card is not supported. Please replace the card or format it to FAT32.
rows.zh: 当前SD卡格式不支持，请更换SD卡或格式化为FAT32格式。

rows.en: The device is currently upgrading. Please try again when it is idle.
rows.zh: 设备正在升级，请待空闲后再试。

rows.en: The accessory firmware does not match the device. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: 配件固件与设备不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: Hotend Change System is busy; please perform the upgrade when it is idle.
rows.zh: 自动热端切换系统正忙，请在空闲时升级。

rows.en: The AMS firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: AMS固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: The Laser Module firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the "Firmware" page.
rows.zh: 激光模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

rows.en: The BirdsEye Camera is malfunctioning. Please try restarting the device. If the issue persists after multiple restarts, check the camera connection status or contact customer support.
rows.zh: 俯视摄像头工作异常，请尝试重启设备。若多次重启仍未恢复，请检查摄像头连接状态或联系客服人员。

rows.en: The device is currently in an upgrade failed state and cannot be upgraded again directly. Please restart the device first, then perform the upgrade.
rows.zh: 当前设备升级失败，无法直接再次升级。请先重启设备后再执行升级操作。

rows.en: The preset device model in the sliced file is incompatible with the current device model. The job cannot be started.
rows.zh: 切片文件中预设机型与当前设备型号不兼容，无法执行任务。

rows.en: The nozzle diameter in sliced file is not consistent with the current nozzle setting. This file can't be printed.
rows.zh: 切片文件中的喷嘴直径与当前设置不符，不能进行打印。

rows.en: The current task does not allow the installation of the laser/cutting module, and the task has been halted.
rows.zh: 当前任务不允许安装激光/模切模组，任务已停止。

rows.en: The current temperature is too low. In order to protect you and your printer, printing tasks, moving an axis and other operations are disabled. Please move the printer to an environment above 10 degrees Celsius.
rows.zh: 当前环境温度过低。为了保护您和打印机的安全，打印任务、轴移动等操作将被禁用。请将打印机移动到10度以上的环境使用。

rows.en: Laser/cutting tasks cannot be initiated on the machine at the moment. Please use the computer software to start the task.
rows.zh: 暂不支持在机器上发起激光/刀切任务，请使用电脑软件开始任务。

rows.en: The current nozzle setting does not match the slicing file. Continuing to print may affect print quality. It is recommended to re-slice before starting the print.
rows.zh: 当前喷嘴设置与切片文件不一致，若继续打印可能影响打印质量，建议重新切片后再开始打印。

variants.00M: The current nozzle setting does not match the slicing file. Continuing to print may affect print quality. It is recommended to re-slice before starting the print.
variants.01P: The current nozzle setting does not match the slicing file. Continuing to print may affect print quality. It is recommended to re-slice before starting the print.
variants.03W: The current nozzle setting does not match the slicing file. Continuing to print may affect print quality. It is recommended to re-slice before starting the print.
variants.093: The current nozzle setting does not match the slicing file. Continuing to print may affect print quality. It is recommended to re-slice before starting the print.
