rows.zh: AMS-HT C 通讯异常，无法继续换料，请拔插 AMS-HT 的连接线。

rows.en: AMS setup failed; please refer to the assistant.
rows.zh: AMS初始化失败，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: AMS-HT C cooling failed. The ambient temperature may be too high. Please operate the device in a suitable environment.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 冷却失败，环境温度可能过高，请在适宜温度下使用设备。

rows.en: AMS set up failed. Please check the assistant for details.
rows.zh: AMS初始化失败，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: Filament track channel switching failed. Possible causes include filament jamming or component damage.
rows.zh: 耗材变轨通道切换失败，可能出现卡料或部件损坏。

rows.en: Failed to feed filament to the extruder. Possible causes include an incorrect AMS–filament track switch binding, tangled filament, a stuck spool, or a disconnected PTFE tube. Please check the assistant for details.
rows.zh: 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是AMS与耗材变轨器匹配关系出错，也可能是耗材缠料、料盘卡住、以及特氟龙管未接上，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: This print requires a Filament Track Switch, but it is currently offline. Please connect the Filament Track Switch and retry.
rows.zh: 本次打印需要使用耗材变轨器，检测到耗材变轨器离线，请接入后重试。

rows.en: The Filament Track Switch was detected while the printer was not idle. Please unplug the Filament Track Switch and reconnect it after the printer enters the idle state.
rows.zh: 检测到在打印机非空闲状态下接入了耗材变轨器。请先拔出耗材变轨器，待打印机进入空闲状态后再接入。

rows.en: Hotend pre-swap check failed.
rows.zh: 热端更换前自检失败

rows.en: Failed to nest hotend into slot 3 on the rack.
rows.zh: 热端放回热端挂架槽位 3 失败。

rows.en: Failed to fetch induction hotend from slot 3 on the rack.
rows.zh: 从热端挂架槽位 3 取出热端失败。

rows.en: Hotend type mismatch detected during printing. Please replace the hotend in slot 3 on the rack with the type specified in the slicer before continuing the print.
rows.zh: 打印过程中检测到热端类型不匹配，请将挂架上 3 槽位的热端更换为与切片软件设置一致的类型后继续。

rows.en: AMS-HT C is disconnected. Please re-plug the AMS cable. Printing will resume automatically once the connection is restored.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C 已断开连接，请拔插AMS连接线，恢复连接后打印将自动继续。

rows.en: An error occurred during AMS-HT C drying. Please go to Assistant for more details.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C烘干异常，请前往助手查看详情。

rows.en: AMS-HT C is reading RFID. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C正在读RFID，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT C is changing filament. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C正在换料，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.zh: AMS-HT C正在送料助力模式，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT C is assisting in filament insertion. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C正在辅助吸料，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT C motor is performing self-test. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT C电机正在自检，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read AMS-HT D filament information.
rows.zh: AMS-HT D 耗材信息读取失败

rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能堵头或耗材卡在挤出机内部。

rows.zh: 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材缠料、料盘卡住、以及AMS特氟龙管未接上。

rows.en: Failed to feed filament to the extruder. Possible causes include an incorrect AMS–filament track switch binding, tangled filament, a stuck spool, or a disconnected PTFE tube. Please check the assistant for details.
rows.zh: 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是AMS与耗材变轨器匹配关系出错，也可能是耗材缠料、料盘卡住、以及特氟龙管未接上，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: This print requires a Filament Track Switch, but it is currently offline. Please connect the Filament Track Switch and retry.
rows.zh: 本次打印需要使用耗材变轨器，检测到耗材变轨器离线，请接入后重试。

rows.en: The Filament Track Switch was detected while the printer was not idle. Please unplug the Filament Track Switch and reconnect it after the printer enters the idle state.
rows.zh: 检测到在打印机非空闲状态下接入了耗材变轨器。请先拔出耗材变轨器，待打印机进入空闲状态后再接入。

rows.en: Hotend pre-swap check failed.
rows.zh: 热端更换前自检失败

rows.en: Failed to nest hotend into slot 5 on the rack.
rows.zh: 热端放回热端挂架槽位 5 失败。

rows.en: Failed to fetch induction hotend from slot 5 on the rack.
rows.zh: 从热端挂架槽位 5 取出热端失败。

rows.en: Hotend type mismatch detected during printing. Please replace the hotend in slot 5 on the rack with the type specified in the slicer before continuing the print.
rows.zh: 打印过程中检测到热端类型不匹配，请将挂架上 5 槽位的热端更换为与切片软件设置一致的类型后继续。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is disconnected. Please re-plug the AMS cable. Printing will resume automatically once the connection is restored.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E 已断开连接，请拔插AMS连接线，恢复连接后打印将自动继续。

rows.en: An error occurred during AMS-HT E drying. Please go to Assistant for more details.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E烘干异常，请前往助手查看详情。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is reading RFID. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E正在读RFID，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is changing filament. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E正在换料，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is in Feed Assist Mode. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E正在送料助力模式，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT E is assisting in filament insertion. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E正在辅助吸料，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT E motor is performing self-test. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT E电机正在自检，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: Failed to read AMS-HT F filament information.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 耗材信息读取失败

rows.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. This might be caused by clogged extruder or filament broken inside the extruder.
rows.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能堵头或耗材卡在挤出机内部。

rows.en: AMS-HT failed to pull back filament. This could be due to a stuck spool or the end of the filament being stuck in the path.
rows.zh: 耗材从工具头退回AMS-HT失败。可能是因为料盘卡住，或者耗材的端头卡在路径中。

rows.en: The AMS-HT failed to send out filament. You can clip the end of your filament flat, and reinsert. If this message persists, please check the PTFE tubes in AMS for any signs of wear and tear.
rows.zh: 耗材送出AMS-HT失败。请取出耗材后，剪平料头重新插入。如果异常继续，请检查AMS内部特氟龙管有无磨损。

rows.en: Unable to feed filament into the extruder. This could be due to an entangled filament or a stuck spool. If not, please check if the AMS-HT PTFE tube is connected.
rows.zh: 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材缠料、料盘卡住、以及AMS特氟龙管未接上。

rows.en: AMS-HT filament has run out. Please load new filament into the original AMS-HT slot to continue.
rows.zh: AMS-HT 耗材已用尽，请将新耗材放入原 AMS-HT 槽位后继续操作。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击"继续"重试。

rows.en: Timeout purging old filament: Please check if the filament is stuck or the extruder is clogged.
rows.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，请检查耗材是否卡住或挤出机堵头。

rows.en: The extruder is not extruding normally; please refer to the Assistant. After trouble shooting. If the defects are acceptable, please resume.
rows.zh: 检测到挤出机无法挤出耗材，请查看助手排除故障。可能在这层出现打印缺陷，如果接受请继续打印。

rows.en: AMS-HT F is drying. Please stop drying process before loading/unloading material.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 在烘干中，无法发起进退料，请停止烘干后重新发起。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file, please retry.

rows.en: AMS-HT F is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT F 已断开连接，请拔插连接线。

rows.zh: AMS-HT F 通讯异常，无法继续换料，请拔插 AMS-HT 的连接线。

rows.en: AMS setup failed; please refer to the assistant.
rows.zh: AMS初始化失败，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: AMS-HT F cooling failed. The ambient temperature may be too high. Please operate the device in a suitable environment.

rows.zh: 检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查从AMS-HT H到挤出机的特氟龙管是否接好。

rows.en: The AMS-HT assist motor is overloaded. This could be due to entangled filament or a stuck spool.
rows.zh: AMS-HT助力电机过载，可能是因为耗材缠住或料盘卡住。

rows.en: AMS-HT filament has run out. Please load new filament into the original AMS-HT slot to continue.
rows.zh: AMS-HT 耗材已用尽，请将新耗材放入原 AMS-HT 槽位后继续操作。

rows.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select "Resume" to retry.
rows.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击"继续"重试。

rows.en: Timeout purging old filament: Please check if the filament is stuck or the extruder is clogged.
rows.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，请检查耗材是否卡住或挤出机堵头。

rows.en: The extruder is not extruding normally; please refer to the Assistant. After trouble shooting. If the defects are acceptable, please resume.
rows.zh: 检测到挤出机无法挤出耗材，请查看助手排除故障。可能在这层出现打印缺陷，如果接受请继续打印。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is drying. Please stop drying process before loading/unloading material.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 在烘干中，无法发起进退料，请停止烘干后重新发起。

rows.en: Failed to get filament-hotend mapping table from the slicing file, please retry.
rows.zh: 获取切片文件中耗材与热端的匹配关系失败，请重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is disconnected. Please re-plug the connecting cable.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 已断开连接，请拔插连接线。

rows.en: AMS-HT H communication error. The filament changing process cannot continue. Please re-plug the AMS-HT connecting cables.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 通讯异常，无法继续换料，请拔插 AMS-HT 的连接线。

rows.en: AMS setup failed; please refer to the assistant.
rows.zh: AMS初始化失败，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: AMS-HT H cooling failed. The ambient temperature may be too high. Please operate the device in a suitable environment.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 冷却失败，环境温度可能过高，请在适宜温度下使用设备。

rows.en: AMS set up failed. Please check the assistant for details.
rows.zh: AMS初始化失败，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: Filament track channel switching failed. Possible causes include filament jamming or component damage.
rows.zh: 耗材变轨通道切换失败，可能出现卡料或部件损坏。

rows.en: Failed to feed filament to the extruder. Possible causes include an incorrect AMS–filament track switch binding, tangled filament, a stuck spool, or a disconnected PTFE tube. Please check the assistant for details.
rows.zh: 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是AMS与耗材变轨器匹配关系出错，也可能是耗材缠料、料盘卡住、以及特氟龙管未接上，请查看助手信息。

rows.en: This print requires a Filament Track Switch, but it is currently offline. Please connect the Filament Track Switch and retry.
rows.zh: 本次打印需要使用耗材变轨器，检测到耗材变轨器离线，请接入后重试。

rows.en: The Filament Track Switch was detected while the printer was not idle. Please unplug the Filament Track Switch and reconnect it after the printer enters the idle state.
rows.zh: 检测到在打印机非空闲状态下接入了耗材变轨器。请先拔出耗材变轨器，待打印机进入空闲状态后再接入。

rows.en: Hotend pre-swap check failed.
rows.zh: 热端更换前自检失败

rows.en: AMS-HT H is disconnected. Please re-plug the AMS cable. Printing will resume automatically once the connection is restored.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H 已断开连接，请拔插AMS连接线，恢复连接后打印将自动继续。

rows.en: An error occurred during AMS-HT H drying. Please go to Assistant for more details.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H烘干异常，请前往助手查看详情。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is reading RFID. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H正在读RFID，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is changing filament. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H正在换料，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is in Feed Assist Mode. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H正在送料助力模式，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT H is assisting in filament insertion. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H正在辅助吸料，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: AMS-HT H motor is performing self-test. Unable to start drying. Please try again later.
rows.zh: AMS-HT H电机正在自检，不能开启烘干，请稍后重试。

rows.en: Failed to cut the filament of the left extruder. Please check the cutter.
rows.zh: 检测到左挤出机切料失败，请检查切刀。

rows.en: The cutter of the left extruder is stuck. Please pull out the cutter handle.
rows.zh: 检测到左挤出机切刀卡住，请拨出刀柄。

rows.en: Please pull out the filament on the spool holder  of the left extruder. If this message persists, please check to see if there is filament broken in the extruder. (Connect a PTFE tube if you are about to use an AMS.)
rows.zh: 请将左挤出机外挂料盘的耗材拉出。如果该消息重复出现，请检查是否有耗材断在工具头。(如后续使用AMS，请连接特氟龙管）

variants.094: Please observe the nozzle of the right extruder. If the filament has been extruded, select "Continue"; if not, please push the filament forward slightly and then select "Retry".
variants.20P: Please observe the nozzle of the right (Aux) extruder. If the filament has been extruded, select "Continue"; if not, please push the filament forward slightly and then select "Retry".
variants.239: Please observe the nozzle of the right extruder. If the filament has been extruded, select "Continue"; if not, please push the filament forward slightly and then select "Retry".
variants.31B: Please observe the nozzle of the right extruder. If the filament has been extruded, select "Continue"; if not, please push the filament forward slightly and then select "Retry".

rows.en: Rack coarse homing failed. Printing has been canceled. Please check if any obstruction is blocking the rack movement.
rows.zh: 挂架粗回中失败，打印已取消，请检查是否有异物阻碍挂架运动。

rows.en: Rack calibration failed, please check the Assistant.
rows.zh: 挂架标定失败，请检查助手。

rows.en: The hotend rack is fully occupied, and hotend switching cannot be performed. Please remove one hotend before proceeding.
rows.zh: 热端挂架上热端已装满，无法进行热端切换。请移除一个热端后继续。

rows.en: The Rack has not been set up. Please complete the Setup before performing a hotend replacement.
rows.zh: 挂架未完成初始化，无法执行热端更换操作。请先在设备上完成初始化后再继续。

rows.en: Rack homing failed due to an obstruction. Please remove the obstacle before resuming printing.
rows.zh: 挂架回中失败，检测到异物阻塞。请清除异物后恢复打印。

rows.en: Rack homing distance is abnormally long. Please check whether the timing belt is loose or broken.
rows.zh: 挂架回中距离过长，请检查同步带是否松动或断裂。

rows.en: Please remove all hotends from the Rack before using Laser Mode or calibrating the Rack position.
rows.zh: 在使用激光模式或进行挂架位置标定前，请先将所有热端从挂架上取下。

rows.en: MQTT command verification failed.
rows.zh: MQTT 命令验证失败。
hint: 部分控制功能需局域网模式及开发者模式。请在 xTouch 中使用局域网设备连接。
Some controls need LAN + Dev mode. Use a LAN profile in xTouch.
